jobs.description:
We proudly offer
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location : Zurich/Basel Work Pattern Percentage : 80% - 100% Are you passionate about shaping the future of supply chains? Ready to dive into cutting-edge technology and make a real difference for global clients? At Deloitte, we’re looking for dynamic, curious, and driven Supply Chain Planning consultants who want to grow their expertise while working on exciting, real-world challenges. How you can make an impact
• Develop deep functional and conceptual knowledge of supply chain planning — from Sales & Operations Planning to Demand Forecasting and beyond.
• Drive innovative, tech-enabled solutions that transform how our clients plan, produce, and deliver.
• Support clients in building robust processes, capabilities, and governance — or guide them through Advanced Planning Systems (APS) assessments, selections, and implementations.
• Advise organisations of all sizes on capacity planning, product launch strategies, materials management, and the latest enabling technologies.
• Prepare reports, proposals, and documentation to support client engagements and business growth.
• Own your projects with autonomy, collaborating closely in small, agile teams.
• Pick your passion: dive into a topic that excites you and develop it through research, a point of view (PoV), or even a client engagement.
• Collaborate regularly with Deloitte’s Supply Chain Planning team to brainstorm solutions and develop ideas for ongoing projects and business development.
• Experience a vibrant mix of working alongside colleagues in our offices and spending time on-site with clients — from corporate HQs to factories — to truly understand their challenges. Who we are looking for
• A management consulting enthusiast with a Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Production Engineering, or a related field.
• Experienced about Supply Chain Planning disciplines like Integrated Business Planning, Inventory Optimisation, Network Design, and Production Scheduling.
• Knowledgeable about Materials Management, Product Launch Planning, and cut-over management.
• Any prior APS (Advanced Planning System) exposure is an asset, either as an end-user, an implementation consultant, or product specialist.
• Independent, proactive, and ready to take ownership in projects where you can shine as a key resource.
• A team player with intellectual curiosity and a hunger to learn continuously.
• Comfortable working in an international environment, including travel abroad when needed.
• Fluent in English. Additional languages such as French or German are a strong bonus.
• Certified or working towards certifications like APICS or other Supply Chain/Operations credentials is a plus. Your Team
• A vibrant, supportive team that’s well connected across EMEA and globally.
• Exposure to end-to-end supply chain transformation projects — from strategy and design to hands-on implementation.
• Opportunities to work with multinational clients across diverse industries including Consumer Business, Life Sciences, Pharmaceuticals, Chemicals, and Industrial Manufacturing.
• Access to extensive internal and external training programmes to boost your skills and career.
• The freedom to explore and develop your own ideas through research, PoVs, or client projects — your growth is in your hands.
• Career progression opportunities aligned with your ambitions and interests.
• A supportive environment where your input is heard, your ideas are taken seriously, and your growth is encouraged. Careers at Deloitte. Choose your impact. At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www. deloitte.com/ch/careers. How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on “apply now” to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates. If you have any questions, please contact Sidorela at talent@deloitte.ch *We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law. Research shows that women are less likely to apply for roles unless they match all the criteria; don’t hold yourself back – apply today. We do not accept applications from recruitment agencies for this position. Deloitte AG and Deloitte Consulting AG are Swiss subsidiaries of Deloitte LLP, the DTTL member firm in the United Kingdom. Requisition ID: 21390

jobs.description:
We proudly offer
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location: Basel, Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Start your career where Global Mobility meets real impact In Global Employer Services , we support internationally mobile employees and executives as they work across borders. Our work ensures that individuals sent on assignments abroad, relocating to Switzerland, or working in multiple countries remain compliant with tax and social security rules; both locally and internationally. You will focus on Swiss Individual Tax , working in a high-impact team to deliver comprehensive solutions that meet the complex needs of our global clients. Your responsibilities
• You will have the opportunity to take ownership from day one , to be involved in client-facing activities in the field of Swiss tax.
• You prepare Swiss tax declarations and analyze complex international tax and social security positions.
• You conduct research and prepare advice tailored to each client.
• You develop specific knowledge in Swiss national and international tax. Combine your strengths and skills with the know-how of our experienced teams – in this power combination you can develop your full professional and personal potential and help our clients in a wide range of tax and social security topics.
• You will have the opportunity to learn and apply your technical knowledge directly to engaging cases. Additionally, you will assist in preparing and delivering presentations to clients and colleagues. What you bring
• Curiosity, proactive mindset, and willingness to take ownership
• Strong teamwork, communication, and problem ‑ solving skills
• Attention to detail and digital mindset (Excel, tools, systems)
• Thrive in an international and fast ‑ paced environment Your profile
• Bachelor’s or Master's degree in law, business, economics, finance or similar
• Applicants without a university degree but with relevant experience (e.g., with social security authorities or tax offices) are encouraged to apply
• Fluent in German & English
• MS Office proficiency
• Previous mobility or tax experience is a plus but not required Your team Join a dynamic and enthusiastic team at our Basel office. jobs.description:
We proudly offer
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location : Zurich, Geneva, Lausanne Work Pattern Percentage : 80-100% Join our Finance Transformation Consulting team and help our clients successfully manage global challenges Our Deloitte Finance Transformation consultants provide support from strategic design, to tool evaluation and implementation for business clients. They determine clients' business needs, create customized and integrated solutions, leveraging the latest technological evolvements. How you can make an impact As a Senior Manager/Director in Finance Transformation, you will:
• Spearhead ERP/EPM-enabled finance transformation initiatives, including ERP/EPM assessment / Phase 0, also leveraging leading platforms to optimise financial processes and reporting.
• Lead and deliver end-to-end finance transformation projects focused on the future of finance, including the design and implementation of Finance Strategy and Target Operating Models definition and implementation of performance steering models.
• Drive Day 1 readiness activities post-integration to ensure seamless finance operations and compliance from day one following mergers or acquisitions.
• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and technology partners to integrate advanced finance solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic business objectives.
• Advise clients on finance strategy, process optimisation, and technology adoption to enhance decision-making, performance management, and value creation.
• Drive business development activities with the team Who we are looking for
• You hold a university degree in Finance, Business, IT, or a related field.
• You bring at least 10 years of experience in Finance Strategy, transformation, or consulting, ideally with exposure to ERP/EPM-enabled finance projects, strategy design, Target Operating Model design and integration readiness.
• Experience in consulting gained within a Big Four firm or a leading consulting market player is required.
• You have a strong understanding of finance processes including controlling, consolidation, planning and reporting.
• You possess excellent communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills.
• You are fluent in English, fluent in German or French with a willingness to travel within Switzerland and internationally.
• Experience working with leading ERP and finance technology platforms is highly desirable. Your team Our Finance Transformation team at Deloitte helps clients navigate complex finance challenges and unlock new performance levels through innovative operating models and technology-enabled solutions. jobs.description:
We proudly offer
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location : Zurich, Basel, Geneva Work Pattern Percentage : 80-100% You bring ambition, we provide opportunities Help our clients navigate the future with confidence and embrace decision making with clear data-driven choices Deloitte AI & Data helps clients unlock the power of AI and data to deliver better human-centric solutions that catalyse growth and efficiencies. We enable them to leverage data, analytics, modern platforms, and data science & AI technologies to uncover hidden relationships from vast troves of data, generate insights, and inform their decision-making. We help clients transform their business by designing and implementing data solutions to excel in their markets. Our role is to understand their business problems and use data-driven thinking and technology to achieve outcomes that drive their business forward. How you can make an impact As a Data Architect in our AI & Data team, you will help senior people at our clients to make the right architectural choices and lead the design and implementation of innovative enterprise-wide solutions. Your will be able to make significant impact in the following areas:
• Lead Enterprise Data Architecture design: help clients modernize complex system landscapes spanning multiple solutions (e.g., MDM, CRM, ERP, Cloud DWH) that need to be integrated. You will work with senior client stakeholders to design enterprise level architecture, pragmatic and enforceable architecture standards, and plan with them the modernization journey.
• Lead Cloud Data Platform design & implementation: help clients build scalable, high-performance Cloud data platforms that meet the business needs. Your work will cover data modelling, data integration, transformation pipelines, DevOps, and use of AI to build and operate these platforms smartly. You will make key design decisions and lead onshore, near-/offshore engineering teams developing the solution.
• Architect Integrated Solutions: help clients design and build integrations required to run their business processes and deliver data products. This may include integration between Cloud data platform and AI/Gen AI platform or between MDM or CRM systems and Cloud data platform.
• Strengthen our market positioning and opportunities funnel: lead our architecture footprint in the market through events, conferences, and discussions with our key clients, internal teams, and alliance partners.
• Develop our internal know-how and expertise: mentor junior team members within AI & Data and set strategic focus for expertise building within Switzerland and in relation to near- and offshore teams. What We Are Looking For:
• Experience:
• You have 8 or more years of relevant professional experience in the role of a Data Architect and have led teams that designed and implemented complex cloud-based ecosystems
• You have engineering background and multiple hands-on data platform end-to-end implementation experiences as a data engineer in the past (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Databricks, Snowflake)
• You are proficient in evaluating and/or taking data architecture decisions, influencing strategic direction and convincing business and IT stakeholders
• You are proficient in guiding data engineers with best practices in coding styles and coding quality and are familiar with industrial coding quality tools such as SonarQube as well as AI coding assistants integrated into IDE
• You have experience across a range of database types, including structured (relational), semi-structured (NoSQL), and graph-based (knowledge graph) models.
• Nice to have: you have experience in packaging data platform solutions into Infrastructure as Code using solutions such as Terraform
• Drive and Motivation:
• Focused individuals looking to grow their careers on the path of becoming Senior Data Architect within AI & Data consulting
• Keen interest and ability to stay on top of technology and architectural trends
• Ability to manage multiple activities in a high-paced environment and context switch without losing focus or big picture
• Leadership, commercial acumen, and communication skills:
• Strong client-facing presence and ability to connect with different senior stakeholders, build relationships, and assess, expand and convert opportunities into projects
• Strong abstract reasoning skills to grasp enterprise level, solution level, and operational concepts and how they link together to form a solution
• Strong communications skills both oral and written and ability to clearly articulate point of view and resonate with technical and business stakeholders
• Strong team leadership skills with ability to partner with externals, estimate and plan the work, and coach team members to deliver optimal client outcomes
• Technical Expertise:
• Strong skills in modelling methods with experience or certifications from DAMA, TOGAF or equivalent:
• Conceptual, logical, and physical data models
• Dimensional modelling
• Data Vault
• Design of normalized and denormalized schemas for analytical and operational workloads and understanding of modelling toolkit
• Hands-on experience in designing and implementing solutions on major cloud platforms:
• Amazone Web Services (AWS)
• Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
• Azure
• Expertise in architecting modern data platforms (Lakehouse, Medallion, Lambda, event-driven) in Snowflake and/or Databricks, or equivalent
• Design E2E architectures that balance performance, cost, and maintainability
• Estimate implementation effort and lead delivery teams
• Create architecture blueprints and solution design documents
• Use of GenAI capabilities to optimize delivery and operation
• Data Integration & ETL
• Design integration layer architecture from multiple sources (ERP, CRM, operational databases, APIs, files)
• Nice to have: Familiarity with ETL/ELT such as Informatica or DBT
• Metadata and event-driven architecture:
• Expertise in metadata and event-driven architecture with the ability to articulate best practices for capturing metadata within a data pipeline
• Ability to leverage metadata to develop event-driven logic within the pipeline for monitoring and alerts
• Enterprise Architectures with strong focus of integrating MDM solutions with data platforms and extending data platform with AI Platform components
• Programming frameworks and data formats:
• Ability to review engineering work done in SQL, Python, Spark
• Familiarity with relational and NoSQL databases, knowledge graphs, and big data file formats (Parquet, Iceberg)
• Language Proficiency:
• Fluent in English; fluency in German and/or French is highly preferred Your team Become part of a diverse and multinational team of 60+ highly motivated individuals located in our Zurich, Geneva, or Basel offices. We specialise in AI & data – how to structure it, how to source it, how to transform it, how to store it, and how to consume it. Join our fast-paced and fun team, working alongside highly talented colleagues on varied and exciting projects, with access to excellent and continuous learning opportunities. Deloitte AI & Data is the leading data & analytics consulting team in Switzerland. You will have a chance to work with outstanding colleagues and have access to variety of clients, vendors, and technologies. Our business is growing fast and there are plenty market opportunities to develop career in the direction that you want. We will help you grow both personally and professionally: through our trainings, mentoring programmes, and on-the-job learning, but also by working with clients and vendors across different industries. jobs.description:
We proudly offer
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location: Zurich, Basel Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Are you passionate about shaping the future of supply chains? Ready to dive into cutting-edge technology and make a real difference for global clients? At Deloitte, we’re looking for dynamic, curious, and driven Supply Chain Planning consultants who want to grow their expertise while working on exciting, real-world challenges. How you can make an impact
• Develop deep functional and conceptual knowledge of supply chain planning — from Sales & Operations Planning to Demand Forecasting and beyond.
• Drive innovative, tech-enabled solutions that transform how our clients plan, produce, and deliver.
• Support clients in building robust processes, capabilities, and governance — or guide them through Advanced Planning Systems (APS) assessments, selections, and implementations.
• Advise organisations of all sizes on capacity planning, product launch strategies, materials management, and the latest enabling technologies.
• Prepare reports, proposals, and documentation to support client engagements and business growth.
• Own your projects with autonomy, collaborating closely in small, agile teams.
• Pick your passion: dive into a topic that excites you and develop it through research, a point of view (PoV), or even a client engagement.
• Collaborate regularly with Deloitte’s Supply Chain Planning team to brainstorm solutions and develop ideas for ongoing projects and business development.
• Experience a vibrant mix of working alongside colleagues in our offices and spending time on-site with clients — from corporate HQs to factories — to truly understand their challenges. Who we are looking for
• A seasoned management consulting professional with strong experience in supply chain, operations, planning, or digital transformation.
• At least 2 years of experience in a consulting company is highly preferred.
• Strong knowledge of Supply Chain Planning disciplines, including Integrated Business Planning, Inventory Optimisation, Network Design, and Production Scheduling.
• Previous exposure to APS implementation is strongly preferred, either as an implementation consultant, product specialist, solution expert, or advanced end-user.
• Exposure to Materials Management, Product Launch Planning, and cut-over management is a plus.
• Knowledge of AI applications in supply chain, planning, operations, or consulting is a strong plus, especially for someone who has worked with AI-enabled tools or use cases and can bring creative ideas to client projects.
• Able to take ownership of workstreams, manage stakeholders, and act as a trusted advisor to clients and internal teams.
• Independent, proactive, and confident operating in projects where you can contribute as a key senior resource.
• A collaborative team player with intellectual curiosity, a continuous improvement mindset, and the ability to coach more junior colleagues.
• Comfortable working in an international environment, including travel abroad when required.
• Fluent in English. Additional languages such as French or German are a strong bonus.
• Certifications such as APICS or other Supply Chain/Operations credentials are a plus. Your Team
• A vibrant, supportive team that’s well connected across EMEA and globally.
• Exposure to end-to-end supply chain transformation projects — from strategy and design to hands-on implementation.
• Opportunities to work with multinational clients across diverse industries including Consumer Business, Life Sciences, Pharmaceuticals, Chemicals, and Industrial Manufacturing.
• Access to extensive internal and external training programmes to boost your skills and career.
• The freedom to explore and develop your own ideas through research, PoVs, or client projects — your growth is in your hands.
• Career progression opportunities aligned with your ambitions and interests.
• A supportive environment where your input is heard, your ideas are taken seriously, and your growth is encouraged. Careers at Deloitte. Choose your impact. At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.deloitte.com/ch/careers . How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on "apply now" to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates. If you have any questions, please contact Sidorela at talent@deloitte.ch *We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law. Research shows that women are less likely to apply for roles unless they match all the criteria; don’t hold yourself back - apply today. We do not accept applications from recruitment agencies for this position.

jobs.description:
We proudly offer
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location : Basel Work Pattern Percentage : 80-100% Advance your career where Global Mobility drives strategic impact In Global Employer Services , we support internationally mobile employees and executives as they work across borders. Our work ensures that individuals sent on assignments abroad, relocating to Switzerland, or working across multiple countries remain fully compliant with tax and social security regulations—both locally and internationally. As a Senior Tax Consultant, you will focus on Swiss Individual Tax , working within a high-impact team to deliver comprehensive, tailored solutions that address the complex needs of our global clients. You will be entrusted with increased ownership and responsibility, leading client engagements, mentoring junior colleagues, and contributing to the development of innovative tax strategies. Your expertise will be instrumental in shaping client success and driving the growth of our practice. Your responsibilities
• You will have the opportunity to take ownership from day one , to be involved in client-facing activities in the field of Swiss tax.
• You will be the primary driver of a client engagement team , steering tax compliance delivery, managing engagement finances, and providing regular outcome and risk reports to the manager to ensure client‑centric and efficient execution. You will also integrate, mentor and develop junior team members .
• You will lead and manage Swiss and international tax compliance projects, including review of Swiss tax declarations and analyze complex international tax and social security positions.
• You will review advice tailored to each client, supported by thorough research and up-to-date knowledge of Swiss and international tax laws.
• You will further develop specific knowledge in Swiss national and international tax. Combine your strengths with the know-how of our experienced teams to unlock your full professional and personal potential, supporting clients across a broad spectrum of tax and social security topics.
• You will have the opportunity to apply your technical knowledge to challenging cases and assist in delivering presentations to clients and colleagues.
• You will lead complex tax consulting briefings with clients on intricate cross‑border assignments, providing clear, practical advice on Swiss tax and social‑security implications. You will build and maintain client relationships as the primary point of contact, coordinate with international teams on multi‑jurisdictional matters. What you bring
• Strong technical knowledge of Swiss national tax laws and international tax principles, including social security regulations related to cross-border mobility.
• Curiosity, proactive mindset with a willingness to take ownership and drive projects forward independently.
• Excellent teamwork and communication skills—both written and verbal—with the ability to explain complex tax matters clearly to clients and colleagues.
• Great analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.
• Proficiency in MS Office applications and familiarity with tax software and digital tools.
• Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented, multicultural environment and fast-paced environment Your profile
• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in law, business, economics, finance or similar
• 3–5 years' experience in individual taxation (German: Natürliche Personen) and social security law, gained in a trust/fiduciary practice, tax authority, social security administration or consulting firm.
• Preferred experience (non‑mandatory): Experience in global mobility, expatriate or international tax advisory, including cross‑border work for multinational clients.
• Commitment to continuous learning and professional development.
• Fluent in German and English

jobs.description:
We proudly offer
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location: Basel, Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Help our clients successfully transform their business through technology Our Deloitte SAP consultants evaluate, develop and implement SAP systems for business clients. They determine clients' business needs, create customized SAP solutions, and smoothly integrate SAP applications with existing IT infrastructure. The SAP team delivers business focussed transformation programmes supported by process design, people solutions and technology. We focus on realizing operational improvements and efficiencies across business operations. We partner with the most renowned technology providers globally and combine their tools with our proven expertise to offer the best solutions to our clients. How you can make an impact
• You will support exciting large-scale projects in Switzerland and abroad
• You will accompany clients from the conceptual design of initial ideas to successful implementation in operations, leading the SAP Procurement workstream
• You will be working on the assumption of sub-project manager tasks within the scope of new implementations
• You will design and extend SAP standard software solutions
• You will be working on the development of customer applications and the integration of various software solutions Who we are looking for
• You have a University degree (Master's, MBA or PhD) and at least 2 year's professional experience in a SAP environment; exposure to S/4HANA is an advantage
• You have a good understanding of and practical experience in SAP MM and/or SAP Ariba procurement solution and its integrations with other systems. You should ideally hold a certification in SAP MM and/or SAP Ariba.
• You have experience in SAP MM configuration, including material master data, purchasing. Experience in configuring goods movement, inventory management, and valuation would be an advantage
• You have experience in SAP Ariba, including master data, workflows, guided buying, Ariba buying, Ariba invoice management, and experience in configuring PtP/Ariba Network
• You have skills acting as an SAP enabler and communicator between technical experts and the business
• You work independently, take the initiative and are happy taking on responsibility. You have excellent technical and analytical skills, are a reliable team player and have experience managing staff
• You are happy to travel in the area of Switzerland and would also be prepared to work abroad, and you communicate confidently in German and English. Any further languages would be an advantage Your team Our Deloitte SAP team can help transform organizations and take them to new levels of performance with a suite of solutions centred on the leading-edge SAP S/4 HANA platform. jobs.description:
We proudly offer
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location: Basel, Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Help our clients successfully transform their business through technology Our Deloitte SAP Order to Cash consultants own the capabilities which are required to evaluate, develop and implement a wide range of SAP integrated systems solutions which are required to cover our clients the business for business needs of our clients. They determine clients' business needs, create customized SAP solutions, and smoothly integrate SAP applications with existing IT infrastructure. The SAP team delivers business focussed transformation programmes supported by process design, people solutions and technology. We focus on realizing operational improvements and efficiencies across the business operations. As SAP Global Platinum partner, we closely partner with SAP with the most renowned technology providers globally, Deloitte and combine SAP their tools and functionalities with our proven expertise to offer the best solutions to our clients. How you can make an impact
• You will support exciting large-scale projects in Switzerland and abroad
• You will accompany clients from the conceptual design of initial ideas to successful implementation in operations.
• You will be working on the assumption of sub-project manager tasks within the scope of new implementations
• You will design and extend SAP standard software solutions
• You will be working on the development of customer applications and the integration of various software solutions Who we are looking for
• You have a University degree (Master's, MBA or PhD) and at least 2 year's professional experience in a SAP environment; exposure to S/4HANA is an advantage
• You have a good understanding of and practical experience in one or more of the SAP Order to Cash domains such as: S/4 HANA Expert Track (Basic Functions, Sales and Shipping) S/4 HANA Service Management S/4 HANA for Advanced ATP Global Trade Management and Compliance (GTS) SPA billing and Revenue Innovation Management (BRIM) OTC Advanced Intercompany SAP Advanced Track and Trace (ATTP) SAP Commerce Cloud Plan To Make domains, such as: SAP S4HANA (Materials Management, Inventory Management) SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) SAP Transportation Management (TM) SAP Production Planning (PP) SAP MES SAP Quality Management (QM) SAP Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) SAP Intelligent Asset Management (IAM) solutions (e.g., ECC, EWM, MDG, MM, PP, GTS, Ariba)
• You have the skills acting as an SAP enabler and communicator between technical experts and the business
• You work independently, take the initiative and are happy taking on responsibility. You have excellent technical and analytical skills, are a reliable team player and have experience managing staff
• You are happy to travel in the area of Switzerland and would also be prepared to work abroad, and you communicate confidently in German and English. Any further languages would be an advantage Your team Our Deloitte SAP team helps to transform our client’s organization and take it to new levels of performance with a suite of solutions centred on the leading-edge SAP S/4 HANA platform. We work with them to plan and implement a full suite of solutions in areas such as enterprise transformation, finance, and supply chain, incorporating advanced technology applications such as GenAI, blockchain, and IoT. Careers at Deloitte. Choose your impact. At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.deloitte.com/ch/careers . How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on “apply now" to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates. If you have any questions, please contact Sophia at talent@deloitte.ch *We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law. Location: Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Join Our Finance Transformation Team Position Overview We are seeking an experienced Financial Consolidation & Reporting consultant to join our Finance Transformation team. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in financial consolidation processes and regulatory reporting, combined with strong technical proficiency in leading consolidation platforms. Key Responsibilities
• Design, implement, and maintain financial consolidation and regulatory reporting processes
• Manage end-to-end consolidation cycles, including data validation, intercompany eliminations, and financial statement preparation
• Develop and optimize regulatory reporting solutions to ensure compliance with local and international standards
• Configure and customize consolidation platforms to meet business requirements
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Finance, Accounting, IT) to streamline processes and improve data quality
• Provide technical support and training to end-users on consolidation tools and best practices
• Document processes, workflows, and system configurations for knowledge management
• Identify opportunities for process automation and continuous improvement Required Qualifications
• 4-7 years of professional experience in financial consolidation and/or regulatory reporting
• Advanced proficiency in at least one of the following platforms:
• CCH Tagetik
• Oracle FCCS
• OneStream
• Fluent in English and German (both written and spoken)
• Strong understanding of IFRS and local GAAP requirements
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
• Proven ability to manage complex projects and meet tight deadlines
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills
• Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with multiple consolidation platforms
• Knowledge of other financial systems (ERP, data warehousing)

jobs.description:
We proudly offer
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location: Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Help our clients realize their full potential At Deloitte, our experts develop strategies and solutions that help our customers manage even the most complex of problems. Is business consultancy your kind of work? Then we're the right company for you. How can you make an impact Our Deloitte SAP consultants specialize in evaluating, developing, and implementing SAP systems tailored to the unique needs of our business clients. By thoroughly assessing clients' business requirements, we create bespoke SAP solutions and ensure seamless integration with their existing IT infrastructure. Our SAP team is dedicated to delivering business-focused transformation programs, underpinned by robust process design, innovative people solutions, and cutting-edge technology. We are committed to driving operational improvements and efficiencies across all facets of business operations. By partnering with globally renowned technology providers and leveraging their advanced tools, combined with our proven expertise, we offer unparalleled solutions to our clients. Who are we looking for
• You have a university degree (Bachelor, Master, MBA, or PhD) or any comparable education and work experience (e.g HF, federal diploma)
• You have knowledge of business processes and experience in preparing recommendations for process optimization
• You have professional experience in Consulting in SAP Finance and Controlling and had exposure to Sustainability regulations (CSRD, ESRS, CBAM, etc.)

Job Description Entry 1 Location: Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Join Deloitte Switzerland’s Technology Risk Team Empower organisations through leading technology risk & control management practices Are you passionate about technology risk and controls? At Deloitte Switzerland, within our Controllership & Treasury team in Technology & Transformation, you will play a pivotal role in helping organisations manage and transform their technology risk frameworks. Your work will help organisations strengthen their internal controls, ensuring compliance and operational excellence in a dynamic environment. Day-to-day, you will contribute to technology risk & controls transformation projects and provide expert guidance on technology risk improvements. What You’ll Do
• Lead strategic initiatives to support clients in assessing technology risks, defining control scopes, and designing or enhancing IT controls and compliance frameworks
• Lead internal controls transformation initiatives (e.g. automation), delivering pragmatic and innovative solutions to complex technology risk challenges.
• Identify emerging technology risk issues and convert them into actionable business opportunities.
• Collaborate across multidisciplinary teams to support go-to-market strategies and develop cutting-edge technology risk advisory offerings.
• Contribute to the creation of innovative tools and assets that drive the future of technology risk and controls transformation. Who we are looking for
• A proactive, adaptable, keen to grow and have strong interpersonal and communication skills and focused on building good relationships with clients
• Minimum of 4 - 6 years of experience in IT controls advisory, audit, or risk management, including risk assessment, control design, testing, and remediation.
• Proven expertise in internal controls design, implementation, and continuous improvement.
• Solid knowledge of IT risk and governance frameworks such as COBIT, ISO 27001, and NIST. Knowledge of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML), with the ability to leverage AI-driven insights in control environments.
• Holder of relevant certifications such as CRISC, CISA, CISM, COBIT , CGEIT, or equivalent.
• Fluent in English and German, with the ability to engage effectively with diverse stakeholders. Your Team & Career Growth Our Controllership & Treasury team, part of Technology & Transformation, has been one of the fastest-growing teams in Switzerland over the last years. Thus, we can offer unrivalled career growth & learning opportunities as well as an exciting place to work. Successful candidates will get the opportunity to help us shape the future of compliance, develop further our market offering and work closely with the world-top organizations on their controls transformation journey. jobs.description:
We proudly offer
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location: Geneva/Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80% - 100% Help our clients to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of their companies By joining our Valuation and Modeling team, you will learn how to support finance and corporate leaders make complex strategic investment decisions, analyse enterprise performance, develop financial business plans, and quantify the success of M&A deals and value creation initiatives. We bring in-depth corporate finance knowledge and experience, coupled with valuation expertise and financial modeling capabilities, to our clients’ most complex transactions, transformations, and corporate events around the globe. How you can make an impact
• Be part of of a team of highly specialised Valuation & Modelling practitioners, combining core capabilities across finance, capital markets, corporate development & investment, financial planning, M&A, and strategy.
• Lead diverse projects across a range of industries, from valuing businesses and assets, to building financial models that capture a company’s economic essence, to working with Boards and the C-Suite on quantifying and creating shareholder value.
• Assess our clients’ financial and business challenges, evaluate suitable solutions based on quantitative analysis, market research, data modeling, and strategic business planning.
• Provide support in the valuation of businesses and intangible assets (e.g. brands, customer relationships, IP portfolios, etc.) for mergers and acquisitions, litigation support, dispute resolution, financial reporting, purchase price allocations, restructuring, and financial advisory.
• Perform research and analysis on various sectors and industries and prepare financial and economic analyses on companies, comparable transactions and public companies using Deloitte databases and other publicly available information.
• Develop detailed financial models in Excel using best practice financial modelling techniques, in the context of transactions, financing, capital investment decisions, and strategic corporate planning. Use these models to analyze and forecast financial outcomes and assist in decision-making processes.
• Present findings and analysis in compelling presentations and reports to effectively communicate insights and recommendations. Who We Are Looking For
• You are a curious and committed team player with the ability to learn and apply new information quickly, who likes to work methodically with great attention to detail, willing to take on responsibility and adopt a proactive attitude in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and to thrive under pressure.
• You have 3-5 years of post-university experience applying the core tenets of valuation and corporate finance in the context of transactions or corporate planning, as well as a high proficiency in building advanced financial models, within another consulting firm, private equity, M&A, FP&A or corporate development practice.
• You are a CFA charterholder or in the process of completing CFA.
• You bring demonstrable capabilities in corporate finance with a track record of building complex financial models, together with a fluency in valuation and accounting principles and standards.
• You are equipped with advanced skills in Excel and Powerpoint.
• Fluent in English and German (oral and writing skills), French would be an advantage. Your Team We are a highly strategic, advisory-driven Valuation & Modelling practice, experiencing strong growth within the Swiss market. Our team is diverse, multinational, and entrepreneurial, split between Zurich and Geneva. A career within our Valuation & Modelling team will equip you with market-leading skills and experiences, and support your development with comprehensive mentoring and internal and external training programmes. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. • Business, Technology & Data Savvy: You possess good knowledge of the core business processes and underlying IT tools, and are data literate

• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location: Zurich, Geneva Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% You bring ambition, we provide opportunities. Help our clients to find vulnerabilities before cyber-criminals do Do you enjoy the thrill of hacking into systems on online training platforms or bug bounty programs? Would you like to turn your passion into a career and help us protecting our clients’ systems? Do you want to elevate your career at the global leader in cyber security consulting and grow your career as ethical hacker / penetration tester? As an ethical hacker / penetration tester, you will work with clients across various industries to ensure their applications and infrastructure are secure. You will be supported by your team who will help you to leverage your prior experience while growing and building up your penetration testing expertise and staying up to date with the latest tools, techniques, and procedures. How you can make an impact
• Perform penetration tests for web and mobile applications and other security assessments such as code reviews where technical skills are essential
• Document your findings in a high-quality, easy to read report, present it to the client and explain the steps required for remediation
• Share your expertise as part of projects in the area of cyber security, including red teaming, secure software development and attack surface management.
• Participate in team problem solving efforts and offer ideas to solve client issues
• Support business development activities such as supporting the proposal creation process, which includes establishing an understanding of the problems our clients would like to address and designing our solution/response. Who we are looking for
• You have minimum 3 years experience in cyber security, ideally as a penetration tester
• You participated in CTF events, hacking challenges such as Hack The Box or bug bounty programs
• You have a completed Bachelor or Master’s degree with a strong academic record in computer science or a similar field
• A good understanding of the OWASP Top 10 and penetration testing related certifications such as OSCP or OSWE are a strong advantage
• Software development skills would be a plus
• Experience in vulnerability management would be an added advantage.
• You are completely fluent in English, fluency in German and/or French is a strong advantage Your team Become part of a diverse, multinational and highly motivated team of around 70+ Cybersecurity professionals at our Zurich, Basel, Geneva or Lausanne office. jobs.description:
We proudly offer
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location: Zurich, Basel, Geneva Working time percentage: 80% - 100% You bring ambition, we provide opportunities Our Treasury Advisory practice supports customers to solve complex Treasury problems ranging from strategy development, policy enhancements and process optimisation to system implementations, using deep Treasury process and technology expertise. The Treasury Advisory team delivers treasury focussed transformation programmes based on a holistic process design approach, implemented using cutting edge solutions and technology. We partner with global technology providers and combine their tools with our proven expertise to offer effective solutions to our clients. How you can make an impact Your responsibilities will comprise of the following:
• Support the implementation of treasury management systems, such as SAP TMS / Kyriba / FIS and others
• Support large SAP S/4HANA transformation programs by leading the treasury workstream
• Execute the delivery of Treasury Advisory projects involving analysis of treasury operating models, optimising treasury guidelines and policies, optimising banking, cash and payment processes and solutions, implementing in-house banking and payment factory solutions, and related process improvements.
• Support in Treasury Health Check / Review / Internal Audit engagements to help clients assess and benchmark their Treasury organisation, processes and systems with market best practices In addition to delivering projects, you will be a key member of the Treasury Advisory team, responsibilities include:
• Support in facilitating Treasury conferences, workshops and customer focused events
• Manage Engagement Delivery and present project deliverables to client (senior) management
• Generate Leads by engaging with clients within the Swiss market and within the wider European market by collaborating with other Treasury experts within the Deloitte network
• Lead and Coach junior team members in the team Who we are looking for
• Subject Matter Expertise in Corporate Treasury processes and systems (3+ years’ experience)
• Experience in the design and implementation of Treasury Management Systems, e.g.:
• Implementation experience in Kyriba or least one other treasury system (e.g. FIS, ION, Coupa, etc.)
• Knowledge in one or more SAP modules in the area of Treasury (Treasury & Risk Management, Cash Management, In-House Cash, Advanced Payment Management)
• Experience in the Swiss market with a network of fellow Treasury professionals
• Consulting experience and analytical and design thinking with a zeal for problem solving
• A passion for exchanging knowledge and ideas with your colleagues
• Positivity and enthusiasm, with an eagerness to learn and build a robust career in Treasury consulting
• Strong Written and Oral communication skills
• Fluent English and German language skills Your team Our Treasury Advisory team belongs to the wider Finance Transformation practice and is committed to helping clients transform their Finance organization by designing and implementing solutions in enterprise, finance and supply chain, treasury transformations, incorporating advanced technology applications such as artificial intelligence and IoT. jobs.description:
Location : Zurich Work Pattern Percentage : 80-100% Join Deloitte Switzerland’s Third-Party Advisory & Technology Implementation team and empower organisations through technology‑enabled transformation journeys In a world that is constantly driven by emerging risks and technological advances, organisations need to adapt quickly to remain competitive in the market. The Third Party Advisory and Implementation team assists in identifying, evaluating and mitigating risks associated with external business relationships through advisory, implementation and operate services. We focus on enhancing the maturity of our client’s third party Management (TPM) processes, covering both third party risk management (TPRM) and contract lifecycle management (CLM) activities. This includes setting up Third Party Management frameworks to deploying technologies to manage third party relationships. The Third Party Advisory team drives the growth of TPRM and CLM technology implementations across industries by building strong relationships with leading vendors and combining deep product knowledge with market leading TPRM and CLM strategy and design expertise. How you can make an impact We have a new and exciting opportunity for someone to join our Zurich-based team as a Technology Solution Senior Consultant, to help support the growth of our implementation capability and deliver complex large-scale technology transformation journeys. The role would involve working directly with senior leaders within the team to deliver the implementation of cloud-based SaaS TPRM and/or CLM solutions to clients, including the integration of these solutions with existing client platforms. In addition, the role will provide a great opportunity to develop leading methodologies for delivery of these implementation projects and to support eminence activity with key TPRM and CLM technology vendors. What you’ll do: As a Third Party Advisory and Technology Solution Senior Consultant with experience of large-scale technology implementations, you will have responsibility for:
• Analysing a client’s TPRM and/or CLM processes, and providing advisory services to enhance their existing ways of working
• Supporting clients in technology capability assessments, and identifying configuration and integration opportunities for the client’s selected TPRM and/or CLM technology
• Translating business requirements into technology capabilities, and developing an end-to-end implementation plan based on the TPRM and/or CLM technology selected, including configuration plans, UAT scripts, and integration strategies
• Supporting the business and technical teams during design, build, test and deployment phases of a TPRM and/or CLM Technology Implementation
• Configuring and build integration solutions that meet the client’s business requirements
• Leading delivery of detailed integration architecture including software and infrastructure components - considering functionality, data, security, integration, infrastructure and performance
• Creating and maintaining technical documentation where required for the implementation Who we are looking for:
• Technical solution experience, ideally on large scale, complex cloud-based SaaS implementations
• Specific experience with configuring and implementing market leading TPRM or Contract Management Technologies (e.g. OneTrust, ProcessUnity, ServiceNow, Icertis, Sirion, DocuSign)
• In-depth understanding of the different integration vendors and technologies, and key differences between these
• Experience of acting within a Solution Architect role and proven expertise in an IT development background.
• Knowledge of artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities, with the ability to leverage AI-driven insights within daily tasks
• Knowledge or experience working in the area of Risk Consulting and/or professional services will be considered an advantage
• Fluency in English is mandatory; German would be considered an advantage What you bring to succeed in the role
• Highly organised individual with strong attention to detail and able to manage their own workload
• Strong communication skills, written and verbal, both internally and externally with clients and third parties, and be able to communicate clearly and effectively to all levels
• Ability to build professional relationships and rapport within the team and its clients
• Proactive, self-starter & committed individual seeking to add value in the role
• Strong ability to plan around and manage changing environments and priorities throughout a cloud based Saas implementation project for global organizations across multiple workstreams Your Team & Career Growth : Our team, part of Technology & Transformation, has been one of the fastest-growing teams in Switzerland over the last years. Thus, we can offer unrivalled career growth & learning opportunities as well as an exciting place to work. jobs.description:
We proudly offer
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location : Basel, Geneva, Zurich Work Pattern Percentage : 80-100% Help our clients navigate the future with confidence and embrace decision making with clear data-driven choices Deloitte AI & Data helps clients unlock the power of AI and data to deliver better human-centric solutions that catalyse growth and efficiencies. We enable them to leverage data, analytics, modern platforms, and data science & AI technologies to uncover hidden relationships from vast troves of data, generate insights, and inform their decision-making. We help clients transform their business by designing and implementing data solutions to excel in their markets. Our role is to understand their business problems and use data-driven thinking and technology to achieve outcomes that drive their business forward. How you can make an impact
• Design and implement modern data solutions in the areas of data management (e.g. data quality, master and reference data, catalogues, data platforms) that deliver high-quality, usable data
• Develop data strategies that allow our clients to reach their business objectives across regulatory, cost, and revenue pillars.
• Design complex data & analytics transformations by providing architectural, technical and organizational thought leadership and guide clients in executing these transformations, which have significant organizational implications.
• Drive Data & AI use cases from business value concept to production
• Develop and maintain trusted client relationships through project work or business development and expand your network both internally and externally.
• Support business development opportunities to generate new projects.
• Be a role model for people you work with by demonstrating strong work ethic, leadership, and subject matter competence.
• Grow expertise in different industry and subject matter areas and share your knowledge with the rest of Deloitte talent. What We Are Looking For:
• Drive and Motivation:
• Passionate individuals looking to make a career in AI & Data space.
• Drive to learn new topics and master them
• Ability to manage multiple activities in a high-paced environment and deliver independently.
• Consulting and Communication Skills:
• Strong Microsoft Power Point skills: Ability to design and shape meaningful presentations.
• Strong Conceptual Capability: Ability to consolidate diverse requirements into coherent solution designs, simplifying complex problems.
• Business-IT Translator: Ability to act as the bridge between business needs and technical solutions.
• Technical design: Attention to detail and ability to convey technical specifics of solution design in oral or written form and in 1-1 meetings as well as workshops
• Business Development: Support business development by preparing and leading workshops with prospective clients
• Technical Expertise in one of the following two areas:
• Data management:
• 2+ projects implementing master data management, data quality, reference data or catalogue solutions.
• Leading nearshore/offshore teams on implementations.
• Hands-on experience from vendor selection to implementation and operation of solutions.
• Hands-on expertise working with solutions from one or more of the following vendors (Collibra, Informatica, Azure, GCP).
• Cloud-based data platforms:
• 2+ projects in implementing data lakehouses.
• Leading nearshore/offshore teams in implementations.
• Hands-on experience across the entire journey from vendor selection to implementation and operation of solutions.
• Hands-on expertise in working with solutions from one or more of the following vendors (Azure, GCP, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks).
• Hands-on knowledge of common development methodologies.
• Hands-on expertise in designing and documenting data and technical architecture for these platforms
• Language Proficiency:
• Fluent in English; fluency in German and/or French is highly preferred to facilitate communication with diverse teams and stakeholders.
• Industry Experience:
• You have at least 3 years of relevant practical experience and technical knowledge of data topics gained in a consultancy, tech company or industry. Your team Become part of a diverse and multinational team of 50+ highly motivated individuals located in our Zurich, Geneva, or Basel offices. We specialise in AI & data – how to structure it, how to source it, how to transform it, how to store it, and how to consume it. Join our fast-paced and fun team, working alongside highly talented colleagues on varied and exciting projects, with access to excellent and continuous learning opportunities. Deloitte AI & Data is the leading data & analytics consulting team in Switzerland. You will have a chance to work with outstanding colleagues and have access to variety of clients, vendors, and technologies. Our business is growing fast and there are plenty market opportunities to develop career in the direction that you want. We will help you grow both personally and professionally: through our trainings, mentoring programmes, and on-the-job learning, but also by working with clients and vendors across different industries. Careers at Deloitte. Choose your impact. At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.deloitte.com/ch/careers . How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on “apply now” to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates. If you have any questions, please contact Aarabi at talent@deloitte.ch *We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law. Research shows that women are less likely to apply for roles unless they match all the criteria; don’t hold yourself back – apply today. • Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location: Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 60-100% Our Audit & Assurance Team is working on finance transformation and accounting advisory projects and delivers internal and external audit engagements. We are collaborating closely across all Service Lines of Deloitte to help our global and diverse customers to achieve their corporate goals, manage their risks and improve their business performance. Do you have strong skills in insurance accounting and reporting, a strong audit or insurance industry background and ready to help our clients in addressing the complex challenges faced by their finance teams? Then we are the right company for you. Are you looking to return to the workplace after an extended career break? We provide tailored coaching and support for this role, specifically designed for returners to help refresh your knowledge and skills and ease your transition back into the workplace after an extended career break. If this applies to you, please inform your recruiter when submitting your application. What you can expect from us
• You advise clients on the implementation of internal control frameworks, finance transformation and new International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS & US GAAP) of particular importance to the Insurance Industry.
• You will conduct external audit engagements for both national and international insurance clients, ensuring compliance with relevant national / international reporting standards and regulatory requirements.
• You will help the clients incorporate new regulatory requirements and related processes into their daily business and prepare their systems through testing the clients in harmonizing of existing and development of new reporting processes for financial and non-financial data in (re)insurance
• You will conduct internal audits and FINMA regulatory assignments for Insurance and Reinsurance companies Your qualifications
• You are currently pursuing your Swiss CPA or ACCA qualification and have 2 to 5 years of practical experience in accounting or auditing within the financial services sector
• You have a minimum of 2 years of experience in external auditing in the insurance field, ideally at one of the Big 4, or minimum 3 years of experience with an insurance company’s accounting/reporting function
• You are a team player and able to work well with individuals from other areas and with customers to build up customer relationships
• You communicate confidently in English as well as German. Any further languages would be an advantage Your team Become part of a diverse, multinational and highly motivated team of 22 at our Zurich office. jobs.description:
Location : Zurich Work Pattern Percentage : 80% - 100% We work across the full breadth of the actuarial profession: financial risk and capital management, life insurance, non-life (P&C) insurance, and pensions. From consulting in reserving and pricing to valuations, M&A and regulatory projects, our clients rely on us to navigate the decisions that shape their organizations, and they value that we can see those decisions from more than one angle. In this role you'll join a highly motivated, genuinely cross-disciplinary team where you'll make an immediate impact. From day one you'll move between client projects in different domains, contribute to winning new business, and help us shape how we work. You bring ambition, we provide opportunities. Businesses face constant change, and they need multidisciplinary experts who can connect the dots across their whole risk picture. That's the team we've built, and it's the team we want you to strengthen. You'll work on audit and assurance engagements with diverse, major organizations alongside our talented professionals. You'll have the autonomy to work independently while drawing on the guidance and expertise of experienced colleagues who are invested in your success. Your contributions directly shape how we evolve our services and accelerate your own professional development.
• Partner directly with clients on engagements that span life and non-life insurance, financial risk, and pensions, bringing insight from one field to problems in another.
• Execute the sophisticated work at the core of our practice: consulting on reserving and pricing, actuarial valuations, capital and solvency modelling, ALM, embedded value, and the analyses that underpin audit and assurance engagements.
• Analyse, synthesise, and communicate clear insights on M&A and due diligence, across insurance portfolios, pension obligations, and the financial structures that tie a deal together.
• Apply the relevant frameworks confidently, whether that's IFRS 17 and Solvency II for insurance, IAS 19 and ASC 715 for employee benefits, or the local statutory bases in between.
• Help win new business through persuasive proposals, thought leadership, and a market presence built on the rare ability to advise across the full actuarial spectrum. Who we are looking for
• You bring 3–6 years of hands-on experience and have worked across more than one actuarial field (life, non-life, insurance, pensions, or actuarial and broader financial risk). We are looking for someone who is already comfortable crossing the lines that usually divide the profession or is curious and open to learn.
• You bring a university degree in a quantitative discipline and genuine fluency with data, modelling, and analysis—the working knowledge that builds when you apply these tools consistently.
• You hold an actuarial or equivalent professional accreditation, or you are determined to earn one.
• You are energised by impact, and you dig deeper, challenge assumptions, and find solutions others miss, qualities that matter even more when no two projects look the same.
• You understand how actuarial work feeds into financial statements and capital positions under international and Swiss frameworks, and can apply that knowledge in practice.
• You understand the Swiss insurance and pension landscape and bring familiarity with other jurisdictions, giving you a genuinely international perspective.
• Fluency in English and German is essential to collaborate seamlessly across our diverse, international clients and teams. Your team Join a diverse, multinational team in our Zurich office where collaboration and growth go hand in hand. You will work in a multicultural, team-oriented environment with flat hierarchies, where your voice is heard and your contributions matter. We are committed to your development. • Take on fascinating assurance projects in the realm of Swiss and international financing reporting – in our dynamic, diverse environment!

• Coach junior colleagues “on the job” and inspire, influence and help shape their professional careers
• Work in multidisciplinary teams, where you can implement and develop your finance knowledge daily
• We will support you to successfully pass your education as a Certified Public Accountant and offer you national and international career opportunities as well as an extensive internal and external development programme Who we are looking for
• Maybe you already have a degree in business administration or similar finance field, but in any case, you’re eager to learn more!

jobs.description:
We proudly offer
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location : Switzerland Work Pattern Percentage : 80-100% Join our Finance Transformation Consulting team and help our clients successfully manage global challenges. Our Deloitte Finance Transformation consultants provide support from finance strategy definition and target operating model transformation to tool evaluation, solution design implementation for business clients. They determine clients' business needs, create customized and integrated solutions, leveraging the latest technological solutions. How you can make an impact
• As a Manager/Senior Manager in Finance Transformation for Insurance clients, you will:
• Spearhead ERP/EPM-enabled finance transformation initiatives for insurance clients, including ERP/EPM assessment / Phase 0, also leveraging leading platforms to optimise finance processes and reporting
• Lead and deliver end-to-end finance transformation projects focused on the future of finance, including the design and implementation of Finance Strategy and Target Operating Models definition and implementation of performance steering models
• Drive Day 1 readiness activities in post-merger integration context to ensure seamless finance operations and compliance from day one following mergers or acquisitions
• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and technology partners to integrate advanced finance solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic business objectives
• Advise clients on finance strategy, process optimisation, and technology adoption to enhance decision-making, performance management, and value creation
• Drive business development activities with the team Who we are looking for
• You hold a university degree in Finance, Actuarial, Business, IT, or related field
• You bring at least 7 years of experience in Insurance or Reinsurance Finance. Your background must include direct hands-on experience working in internal finance, actuarial, or risk teams within (re-)insurance companies.
• Alternatively, you have consulting experience in Finance Strategy definition and finance transformation specifically within the (re-)insurance sector. Ideally with exposure to ERP/EPM-enabled finance projects, strategy design, Target Operating Model design and integration readiness in (re-)insurance industry
• You have a strong understanding of finance processes including accounting, controlling, consolidation, planning/FP&A and reporting
• You possess excellent communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills
• You are fluent in English (German is an advantage), with a willingness to travel within Switzerland and internationally
• Experience working with leading ERP and finance technology platforms is highly desirable
• Experience in Financial Services (Insurance or Reinsurance context) and/or consulting experience gained within a Big Four firm or a leading consulting market player in (re-)insurance industry is desirable Your team Our Finance Transformation team at Deloitte helps clients navigate complex finance challenges and unlock new performance levels through innovative operating models and technology-enabled solutions. We combine deep industry knowledge with cutting-edge technology such as AI to transform finance functions globally. Careers at Deloitte. Choose your impact. We proudly offer
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location: Zurich / Vaduz Work Pattern Percentage: 60-80% Your new top job in Switzerland? Join our team of auditors and help our national and international clients achieve their corporate goals and manage their risks: In close collaboration with our professionals, you will conduct audit missions with very diverse clients, working independently while benefiting from the expert advice of our experienced staff. Play a pivotal role at Deloitte: Contribute and actively participate in the development of our services, and enjoy great perks and perspectives to boot! How you can make an impact
• You will be involved in providing auditing and assurance services to our portfolio of international and local banking clients
• Your substantial contribution: financial and regulatory audits, leading audit teams during the fieldwork at clients and managing and coaching junior team members
• Delve into the fascinating world of complex financial areas of the clients' balance sheets, income statements, including goodwill, loan loss provisioning on credit portfolio, financial investments portfolio incl. complex and non-standard investments and taxes
• Shine your light on regulatory areas such as anti-money laundering, internal organisation, client and market conduct, risk management, solvency, consolidated supervision, etc.
• Decisively shape, support and ensure the continued training and development of the audit team Who we are looking for
• Motivated by new challenges and driven by an entrepreneurial spirit, you enjoy working both independently and as part of a team, taking on responsibility and building customer relationships
• You are a Lichtenstein or Swiss accredited Certified Public Accountant (CPA), or you have started your training to become one
• Several (around 6) years of experience in auditing, ideally at one of the Big 4; profound knowledge of accounting principles and FINMA regulatory requirements for banks
• Good level of German and English (additional languages would be an advantage) Your team Become part of a diverse, multinational and highly motivated team. We will help you grow both personally and professionally: through our trainings, mentoring programmes and on-the-job learning, but also by connecting you with your colleagues across all business lines.
