jobs.description:
We proudly offer
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location: Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Join us in helping clients to unlock their full value creation potential during their most challenging M&A transactions! Our M&A practice features a dedicated group of highly qualified individuals. Within this practice, the Corporate Finance Advisory Team provides clients with financial and strategic advice throughout M&A transactions, from scope definition and deal execution to the signing of transaction agreements. Our senior M&A advisors have a long track record of completed deals and are thoroughly trained in bulge bracket investment banks and Big4 corporate finance teams. As an incoming Manager, you will have the opportunity to lead live engagements and make a real contribution to transactions as well as deal generation from day one. You will specialize in one of our core industry pillars: Life Sciences & Healthcare (LS&HC). How you can make an impact

jobs.description:
Was wir mit Stolz bieten:
• Ein sicheres Arbeitsumfeld mit null Toleranz gegenüber Belästigung.
• Offene Arbeitswelten, in denen Menschen sich selbst sein können.
• Eine inklusive Gemeinschaft, die auf Respekt und Leistung basiert. Location: Basel, Bern, Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 60-100% Du bist Wirtschaftsprüferin / Wirtschaftsprüfer und möchtest die Welt verbessern indem du Organisationen und ihre Tätigkeiten auf Herz und Nieren prüfst und so das Vertrauen von Investoren und Stakeholdern stärkst? Deloitte bietet dir diese Möglichkeit als Corporate Audit Manager. Was dich bei uns erwartet
• Wir bieten dir ein dynamisches wachsendes Umfeld, das sich mit schweizer- sowie internationalen Rechnungslegungen und Assurance Projekte beschäftigt
• Du leitest, überwachst und führst Teams, welche nationale und internationale Prüfungs- sowie Assurance-Mandate in verschiedenen Grössenordnungen bewältigen
• Du wirkst bei der Akquisition von Neumandaten mit und sammelst so wertvolle Erfahrungen
• Du erhältst die Möglichkeit, jüngere Kolleginnen und Kollegen zu coachen und sie in internen Trainings auszubilden
• Du arbeitest in multidisziplinären Teams und kannst tagtäglich dein Finance-Wissen einbringen und weiterentwickeln Was du mitbringst
• Du besitzt einen Abschluss als dipl. Wirtschaftsprüferin oder Wirtschaftsprüfer
• Du hast vier bis fünf Jahre Erfahrung in der Durchführung und Leitung von externen Prüfungsmandaten
• Du hast praktische Erfahrungen mit den Rechnungslegungsstandards OR, Swiss GAAP FER, IFRS oder US GAAP
• Du bist belastbar, arbeitest gerne im Team aber auch selbstständig, bist effizient und lösungsorientiert
• Du kommunizierst stilsicher auf Deutsch und Englisch (jede weitere Sprache ist ein Vorteil) und kannst Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen und pflegen Dein Team Werde Teil unseres dynamischen, internationalen und wachsenden Audit Teams an unseren Standorten in Zürich, Basel oder Bern. Über 400 Kolleginnen und Kollegen teilen deine Leidenschaft für die Wirtschaftsprüfung und beschäftigen sich mit Schweizer sowie internationalen Rechnungslegungen und Assurance Projekten. Wir bieten dir zudem nationale und internationale Karrieremöglichkeiten sowie ein umfassendes internes und externes Weiterbildungsprogramm. Arbeiten bei Deloitte Als eine der weltweit führenden Beratungs- und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften engagiert sich Deloitte mit Leidenschaft für die Gestaltung der Zukunft. In der Schweiz bieten wir branchenspezifische Dienstleistungen in den Bereichen Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation an. Mit mehr als 3,000 Mitarbeitenden an sechs Standorten in Basel, Bern, Genf, Lausanne, Lugano und Zürich betreuen wir Unternehmen und Organisationen aller Rechtsformen und Grössen in allen Branchen. Bei Deloitte kannst du etwas bewirken, das für unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Kunden und die Gesellschaft von Bedeutung ist. Wir bieten ein inklusives Umfeld, in dem du deinen eigenen Weg gehen und auf dem aufbauen kannst, das dich antreibt. Du profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitsbedingungen, Gesundheits- und Elternprogrammen und knüpfst lebenslange Beziehungen in einem internationalen und dynamischen Umfeld. Möchtest du mehr über das Arbeiten bei Deloitte erfahren? Besuche https://www2.deloitte.com/ch/de/pages/career.html Bewirb dich Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören! Bitte klicke auf "Jetzt bewerben", um eine vollständige Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf, Motivationsschreiben, Referenzen und Abschlusszeugnissen einzureichen. Bei Fragen wende dich sich bitte an Nadia unter talent@deloitte.ch *All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law. We do not accept applications from recruitment agencies for this position. Deloitte Consulting AG and Deloitte AG are affiliates of Deloitte NSE LLP, a member firm of Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu Limited, a UK private company limited by guarantee (“DTTL”) Requsition code: 19220

jobs.description:
Was wir mit Stolz bieten:
• Ein sicheres Arbeitsumfeld mit null Toleranz gegenüber Belästigung.
• Offene Arbeitswelten, in denen Menschen sich selbst sein können.
• Eine inklusive Gemeinschaft, die auf Respekt und Leistung basiert. Ort: Bern Pensum: 80-100% Unser multidisziplinäres Tax & Accounting Team erbringt integrierte Beratungsleistungen in den Bereichen Steuern, Rechnungswesen und Treuhand. Wir helfen unseren Kunden - vom innovativen Startup bis zum internationalen Grosskonzern - ihre Finanzstrukturen zu optimieren und regulatorische Anforderungen sicher zu erfüllen. Als Manager übernimmst du eine Schlüsselrolle: Du leitest Projekte, entwickelst massgeschneiderte Lösungen und bist ein vertrauensvoller Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden. Mit Sitz in Bern oder Zürich unterstützt du unser Team dabei, massgeschneiderte Lösungen zu entwickeln, die deine Expertise im Rechnungswesen, Steuerrecht und Treuhand vereint und vertieft. So kannst du etwas bewirken
• Abwechslungsreicher Arbeitsalltag mit vielfältigen Treuhand-Aspekten und Problemstellungen
• Umstrukturierungen & Ruling-Anfragen: Komplexe Steueroptimierungen und Behördenkommunikation
• Tax Compliance & Abschlussgestaltung: Strategische Steuerplanung und Rechnungslegung
• Due Diligence: Finanzielle und steuerliche Bewertungen bei M&A-Transaktionen
• Internationale Projekte mit Kunden aus verschiedenen Branchen und Jurisdiktionen
• Fachgebietsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit auf Projekten mit Kollegen und Kolleginnen aus dem Transfer Pricing, Legal, Management Consulting, Audit, Tax Technology, und weiteren Spezialisten
• Zentrale Rolle als Manager bei der Mitwirkung, Koordination und Steuerung der Erbringung hochwertiger Leistungen
• Mentoring und Entwicklung von Junior-Fachleuten
• Aufbau und Pflege von Kundenbeziehungen
• Entfalte dein volles Potenzial in einem Arbeitsumfeld, das von Teamgeist, Vertrauen und gegenseitiger Unterstützung geprägt ist Wen wir suchen
• Dipl. Treuhandexperte, Dipl. Steuerexperte, Dipl. Wirtschaftsprüfer oder gleichwertiger anerkannter Abschluss im Bereich Rechnungswesen oder Steuern
• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in Treuhand, Steuerberatung oder Audit
• Kundenorientierung: Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich zu kommunizieren und Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen
• Führungsqualitäten: Motivation und Entwicklung von Teams
• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse
• Ein bestehendes Kundenportfolio mit der Bereitschaft und dem Potenzial, dieses in das Deloitte-Umfeld zu integrieren Dein Team Du wirst Teil eines dynamischen, wachsenden und kollegialen Teams von Fachleuten, die mit Leidenschaft Spitzenleistungen erbringen. Zusammen werden wir nicht nur an Projekten in der Schweiz arbeiten, sondern auch an spannenden internationalen Projekten. Wir bieten vielfältige Weiterbildungsprogramme, Mentoring-Möglichkeiten und praxisnahe Lernangebote sowie die Gelegenheit, mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus allen Geschäftsbereichen und Standorten zusammenzuarbeiten und sich auszutauschen. Wir haben klare Karrierepfade, flexible Arbeitsmodelle und verfügen über modernste Infrastruktur. Karriere bei Deloitte. Wähle deinen Impact! Bei Deloitte haben deine Ideen echten Einfluss - denn sie entfachen bedeutende Veränderungen für unsere Kunden, Mitarbeitenden und die Gesellschaft. Deine einzigartige Expertise, dein Background und deine Sichtweise helfen uns, neue Wege zur Lösung komplexester Herausforderungen zu finden, damit wir die Zukunft derjenigen verbessern können, die mit uns zusammenarbeiten. Bei Deloitte kannst du dir eine Karriere aufbauen, die inspiriert und motiviert. Wähle deinen Impact! In der Schweiz bieten wir branchenspezifische Dienstleistungen in den Bereichen Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory sowie Technology & Transformation. Mit fast 3.000 Mitarbeitenden an sechs Standorten betreuen wir Unternehmen und Organisationen jeder Grösse und Branche. Wir bieten dir eine sinnvolle und herausfordernde Tätigkeit in einem integrativen und unterstützenden Umfeld, in dem du dein Bestes geben kannst und dich ständig weiterentwickelst. Du profitieren ausserdem von flexiblen, hybriden Arbeitsbedingungen, Eltern- und Employee-Wellbeing-Programmen sowie zahlreichen Möglichkeiten, Kontakte zu knüpfen, zusammenzuarbeiten und zu lernen. Werde Teil eines globalen Netzwerks von Gleichgesinnten, die sich dafür einsetzen, etwas zu bewegen - sei es durch die Bekämpfung des Klimawandels oder die Verbesserung der Zukunft von 100 Millionen Menschen bis 2030. Möchtest du mehr über die Karrieremöglichkeiten bei Deloitte erfahren? Besuche www.deloitte.com/ch/careers . So bewirbst du dich Wir freuen uns, von dir zu hören! Klick einfach auf „Jetzt bewerben“, um deine vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen einschliesslich Lebenslauf, Anschreiben, Referenzen und Abschlusszeugnissen einzureichen. Bei Fragen wende dich bitte an Lena unter talent@deloitte.ch . *Wir berücksichtigen alle qualifizierten Bewerbenden unabhängig von ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, religiöser Überzeugung, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität, nationaler Herkunft, Alter oder Behinderung gemäss geltendem Recht. Studien zeigen, dass Frauen sich seltener auf Stellen bewerben, wenn sie nicht alle Kriterien erfüllen - zögere nicht und bewirb dich noch heute! Wir akzeptieren keine Bewerbungen von Personalvermittlungsagenturen für diese Stelle. Deloitte AG und Deloitte Consulting AG sind Schweizer Tochtergesellschaften von Deloitte LLP, der DTTL-Mitgliedsfirma im Vereinigten Königreich.

jobs.title: Manager - Artificial Intelligence & Data – AI Strategy

titleByLocale.en: Manager - Artificial Intelligence & Data – AI Strategy
titleByLocale.it: Manager - Intelligenza Artificiale e Dati – Strategia di IA
titleByLocale.de: Manager - Artificial Intelligence & Data – AI Strategy
titleByLocale.fr: Manager - Artificial Intelligence & Data – AI Strategy

jobs.description:
We proudly offer
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location : Zurich, Basel, Geneva Work Pattern Percentage : 80-100% You bring ambition, we provide opportunities Help our clients navigate the future by aligning AI innovation with strategic business goals to drive sustainable growth and competitive advantage. Deloitte AI & Data supports clients in unlocking the full potential of AI by bridging the gap between business strategy and technical execution. We enable organizations to embed AI thoughtfully and responsibly into their operations, ensuring measurable business impact and long-term value. How you can make an impact
• Lead the development and execution of AI strategies that align with clients’ business objectives, market dynamics, and regulatory environments.
• Advise senior client stakeholders on AI adoption, governance frameworks, ethical considerations, and risk management to ensure responsible AI deployment.
• Translate complex AI technologies and capabilities into clear business cases, roadmaps, and actionable plans that drive transformation.
• Lead workshops and stakeholder discussions, and advise senior leadership on AI opportunities, risks, and business impact.
• Drive cross-functional collaboration among business leaders, data scientists, engineers, and external partners to identify use cases, prioritise initiatives and lead organisational change.
• Shape and grow Deloitte’s AI strategy practice by contributing to thought leadership, market positioning, and business development activities.
• Mentor and lead teams, fostering a culture of innovation, strategic thinking, and client-centric delivery excellence. Who we are looking for Experience:
• 6+ years of relevant experience in AI strategy, technology consulting, business advisory or strategic industry roles focused on AI and digital transformation.
• Proven experience in client-facing roles or strategic leadership positions, advising senior executives on AI adoption and strategy.
• Strong understanding of AI technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, and generative AI, and their business applications.
• Demonstrated ability to translate AI technologies into business value and strategic initiatives.
• Familiarity with AI governance, ethics, and regulatory considerations in AI deployment. Drive and Motivation:
• Ambitious, strategic thinker with a passion for AI and its potential to transform businesses.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and lead teams in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
• Commitment to continuous learning and staying abreast of AI trends and best practices. Leadership, Commercial Acumen, and Communication Skills:
• Strong client-facing presence with the ability to build trusted relationships at senior levels.
• Excellent communication skills, capable of articulating complex AI concepts in business terms to diverse audiences.
• Skilled in stakeholder management, negotiation, and influencing decision-making.
• Experience leading and developing high-performing teams, managing project delivery, and driving business growth. Technical and Strategic Expertise:
• Strong understanding of AI technology fundamentals and their practical applications.
• Ability to assess AI risks and benefits from a strategic and operational perspective.
• Experience with AI use case identification, prioritisation, and value realisation.
• Understanding of cloud platforms and AI tools (AWS, Azure, GCP, LLMs) is advantageous. Language Proficiency:
• Fluent in English; proficiency in German and/or French is highly preferred to engage effectively with local clients and teams. Industry Experience:
• Candidates having industry experience (e.g., senior roles within Banking, Insurance, Life Sciences, Healthcare, or other regulated sectors) with strong domain expertise are highly valued. . Your team Become part of a diverse and multinational team of 60+ highly motivated individuals located in our Zurich, Geneva, or Basel offices. We specialise in AI & data – how to structure it, how to source it, how to transform it, how to store it, and how to consume it. Join our fast-paced and fun team, working alongside highly talented colleagues on varied and exciting projects, with access to excellent and continuous learning opportunities. Deloitte AI & Data is the leading data & analytics consulting team in Switzerland. You will have a chance to work with outstanding colleagues and have access to a variety of clients, vendors, and technologies. Our business is growing fast, and there are plenty of market opportunities to develop your career in the direction that you want. We will help you grow both personally and professionally: through our trainings, mentoring programmes, and on-the-job learning, but also by working with clients and vendors across different industries. Careers at Deloitte. Choose your impact. At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background, and perspective help us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate, and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.apply.deloitte.ch How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on “apply now” to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates. If you have any questions, please contact Aarabi at talent@deloitte.ch *We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law. Research shows that women are less likely to apply for roles unless they match all the criteria; do not hold yourself back – apply today. We do not accept applications from recruitment agencies for this position. Deloitte Consulting AG and Deloitte AG are affiliates of Deloitte NSE LLP, a member firm of Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu Limited, a UK private company limited by guarantee (“DTTL”) Requisition ID: 21494 AI Strategy

jobs.description:
We proudly offer
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location: Basel, Geneva, Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Help our clients navigate the future with confidence and embrace decision making with clear data-driven choices Deloitte AI & Data helps clients unlock the power of AI and data to deliver better human-centric solutions that catalyse growth and efficiencies. We enable them to leverage data, analytics, modern platforms, and data science & AI technologies to uncover hidden relationships from vast troves of data, generate insights, and inform their decision-making. We help clients transform their business by designing and implementing data solutions to excel in their markets. Our role is to understand their business problems and use data-driven thinking and technology to achieve outcomes that drive their business forward. How you can make an impact
• Work with our clients to modernise their digital landscape using next-generation cloud-based platforms and big data architectures to ensure high data quality
• Design and implement modern data solutions in the areas of data management (e.g. data quality, master and reference data, catalogues, data platforms) that deliver high-quality, usable data
• Develop data strategies that allow our clients to reach their business objectives across regulatory, cost, and revenue pillars.
• Design complex data & analytics transformations by providing architectural, technical and organizational thought leadership and guide clients in executing these transformations, which have significant organizational implications.
• Take responsibility for the holistic management of projects, i.e. from advisory and conception to implementation and introduction of the solution at the customer's site.
• Develop and maintain trusted client relationships through project work or business development and expand your network both internally and externally.
• Define go-to-market strategies for our strategic topics together with our leadership and drive them forward.
• Play a central role with our existing focus customers and establish new customer relationships by responding to customer needs, further expanding existing projects and showing market presence (thought leadership on Linkedin, at conferences or customer events).
• Be part of interdisciplinary and cross-functional teams for the delivery of data management / engineering solutions in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.
• Share your knowledge with younger colleagues and help them to develop professionally and personally What We Are Looking For: Drive and Motivation:
• Passionate individuals looking to make a career in Consulting.
• Experience in leading Data & Analytics teams and projects and track record of working effectively in multidisciplinary teams. Consulting and Communication Skills:
• Management skills: Ability to manage several projects at once and manage conflicting priorities
• Selling skills: Experience in the marketing and sale of consulting or project services
• Strong Presentation skills: Ability to design and shape meaningful presentations.
• Strong Conceptual Capability: Ability to consolidate diverse requirements into coherent solution designs, simplifying complex problems.
• Business-IT Translator: Ability to act as the bridge between business needs and technical solutions. Technical Expertise in one of the following two: Data management:
• Several projects implementing master data management, data quality, reference data or catalogue solutions.
• Leading nearshore/offshore teams on implementations.
• Hands-on experience from vendor selection to implementation and operation of solutions.
• Hands-on expertise working with solutions from one or more of the following vendors (Collibra, Informatica, Azure, GCP). Cloud-based data platforms:
• Several projects in implementing data lakehouses.
• Leading nearshore/offshore teams in implementations.
• Hands-on experience across the entire journey from vendor selection to implementation and operation of solutions.
• Hands-on expertise in working with solutions from one or more of the following vendors (Azure, GCP, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks).
• Hands-on knowledge of common development methodologies.
• Hands-on expertise in designing and documenting data and technical architecture for these platforms
• Ability to articulate hybrid data architectures / options to senior stakeholder groups and to develop and present / defend a point of view Language Proficiency:
• Fluent in English; fluency in German and/or French is highly preferred to facilitate communication with diverse teams and stakeholders. Industry Experience:
• You have 6 or more years of relevant professional experience in a technical or strategic role in the areas of data governance, data management, data engineering or analytics gained in a consultancy, tech company or industry. • Lead AI and analytics engagements from discovery to production
• Design complex data & analytics transformations by providing architectural, technical and organizational thought leadership and guide clients in executing these transformations, which have significant organizational implications.
• Serve as the business–IT translator, facilitating workshops, consolidating diverse requirements into coherent solution designs, and aligning stakeholders around clear decisions.
• Manage cross-functional delivery teams (onshore/nearshore/offshore), ensuring delivery governance, quality assurance, risk management and effective communications.
• Drive Generative and Agentic AI initiatives (where relevant), including LLM-enabled solutions, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, safety guardrails and evaluation approaches aligned to client policies.
• Develop and maintain trusted client relationships through project delivery and account growth; support business development by shaping proposals, POVs and demos, and identifying new opportunities.
• Be a role model for people you work with by demonstrating strong work ethic, leadership, and subject matter competence.
• Grow expertise in different industry and subject matter areas and share your knowledge with the rest of Deloitte talent. What We Are Looking For: Drive and Motivation:
• Passionate about building a career in consulting at the intersection of AI, analytics and business impact.
• Ownership mindset with the ability to manage multiple activities in a fast-paced environment and deliver independently and through teams. Consulting and Communication Skills:
• Strong Microsoft Power Point and storytelling skills: Ability to design and present meaningful, executive-ready materials.
• Strong Conceptual Capability: Ability to simplify complex problems and translate them into actionable solution designs and roadmaps.
• Business-IT Translator: Proficient in requirements leadership, stakeholder alignment and facilitation of client workshops.
• Team Collaboration and Leadership: Proven ability to guide nearshore and offshore technical implementation teams, ensuring effective collaboration and project success.
• Technical Integration: Skilful in integrating system components, providing clear business explanations, and leading technical workshops. Technical Expertise:
• Strong Engineering and/or Mathematics background.
• Solid experience with Python. Experience with R is a plus.
• Experience delivering Generative AI, AI, Machine Learning and/or Analytics solutions on one or more of the cloud services providers: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
• Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs) and adjacent services required to bring use cases to production on one or more of the cloud service providers above is highly preferred.
• Experience with data science workbench tools such as Snowflake, Databricks and Dataiku is a plus.
• Experience with Data Visualization tools such as PowerBI and Tableau is a plus. Language Proficiency:
• Fluent in English; fluency in German and/or French is highly preferred to facilitate communication with diverse teams and stakeholders. Industry Experience:
• At least 6 years of practical experience in consulting, tech companies, or industry-specific roles, particularly in data-driven fields.
• Previous experience in the Banking, Insurance, Life Science or Healthcare sector is advantageous. Was wir mit Stolz bieten:
• Ein sicheres Arbeitsumfeld mit null Toleranz gegenüber Belästigung.
• Offene Arbeitswelten, in denen Menschen sich selbst sein können.
• Eine inklusive Gemeinschaft, die auf Respekt und Leistung basiert. Arbeitsort: Deloitte Schweiz, Zürich Pensum: 80-100% Gestalte die digitale Zukunft bei Deloitte! Bei Deloitte hast du die Möglichkeit, deine Leidenschaft für Informatik in einem dynamischen Umfeld zu entfalten. Unser kontinuierliches Wachstum bietet dir eine spannende Aufgabe mit gro ss em Potenzial, eine teamorientierte Unternehmenskultur sowie modernste und zukunftssichere Arbeitsbedingungen. Die enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kolle g:innen aus aller Welt ermöglicht es dir , internationale Kontakte zu knüpfen und globale Perspektiven zu gewinnen. Deine Expertise und Innovationskraft tragen dazu bei, komplexe Herausforderungen zu meistern und nachhaltige Lösungen für unsere Kunden zu entwickeln. Werde Teil eines Netzwerks von Gleichgesinnten, die sich dafür einsetzen, einen positiven Einfluss auf die Gesellschaft zu nehmen und die Zukunft zu gestalten. Wie Sie einen Unterschied machen können
• Betreue unsere moderne und fortschrittliche IT-Endnutzerumgebung
• Unterstütze deine Kolleg:innen im First- und Second-Level-User-Support vor Ort und remote
• Betreue unsere Windows-PCs, Macs, Smartphones, Konferenzräume und Multimediageräte am Standort
• Betreibe und pflege die Arbeitsplätze und deren technische Infrastruktur
• Bring dein Know-how aktiv in verschiedenen IT-Projekten ein Wen wir suchen
• Du bist eine offene und neugierige Person und blühst bei der Arbeit in einem dynamischen Umfeld auf
• Nach deiner abgeschlossenen Informatik Ausbildung EFZ konntest du mehrjährige (2+) Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Position sammeln
• In deiner bisherigen Laufbahn konntest du dir fundierte Kenntnisse im Support von Windows Clients und Microsoft 365 sowie im Umgang mit ITIL-basierten Ticketsystemen und Prozessen aneignen
• Idealerweise verfügst du über Erfahrung mit Hard- und Software für Konferenzräume (z. B. Microsoft Teams Rooms und Surface Hubs) Dein Team Als neustes Mitglied in einem etablierten und stetig wachsenden Team, das bereits grosse Fortschritte beim erfolgreichen Zusammenspiel zwischen unseren Fachbereichen und der IT gemacht hat, erwartet dich eine aufgeschlossene Gruppe mit diversen Kolleg:innen, die Vielfalt, Einzigartigkeit und den projektübergreifenden Austausch von Ideen schätzen. Innerhalb unserer IT wirst du nachhaltige Beziehungen mit wichtigen Interessenvertretungen (Service Management, Service Owners, Change Delivery und IT-Leitung) knüpfen. Mithilfe dieser Beziehungen wirst du ein tiefgreifendes Verständnis für die Verwaltung und Wartung von Informatikdiensten erhalten. Karrieren bei Deloitte. Wähle deinen Impact. Bei Deloitte haben deine Ideen Wirkung und stossen bedeutsame Veränderungen für unsere Kunden, Menschen und die Gesellschaft an. Deine einzigartige Expertise, Perspektive und dein individueller Hintergrund helfen uns, neue Wege für die komplexesten Herausforderungen zu finden, um so die Zukunft all jener zu verbessern, die von den Auswirkungen unserer Arbeit berührt werden. Bei Deloitte kannst du dir eine Karriere aufbauen, die dich inspiriert und anregt. Bei Deloitte kannst du wirklich etwas bewirken – wie, entscheidest du. In der Schweiz bieten wir branchenspezifische Dienstleistungen in den Bereichen Audit & Assurance, Consulting, Financial Advisory, Risk Advisory und Tax & Legal an. Mit fast 3.000 Mitarbeitenden an sechs Standorten betreuen wir Unternehmen und Organisationen jeder Grösse und aller Branchen. Wir bieten dir eine sinn- und anspruchsvolle Arbeit, einen Ort, an dem du einfach du selbst sein kannst und immer weiter über dich hinauswachsen wirst. Profitiere von unseren hybriden Arbeitsbedingungen sowie von Wohlfühl- und Elternprogrammen sowie vielen Möglichkeiten, sich zu vernetzen, zusammenzuarbeiten und zu lernen. Komm in unser Team und werde Teil eines globalen Netzwerks von Gleichgesinnten, die sich dafür einsetzen, einen echten Unterschied zu machen, ob in Sachen Klimawandel oder indem sie bis 2030 die Zukunftsperspektiven von 100 Millionen Menschen verbessern. Neugierig auf deine Chancen und Möglichkeiten bei Deloitte? Besuche uns auf www.deloitte.com/ch/careers . So bewirbst du dich Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören! Bitte klicke auf „Jetzt bewerben“, um eine vollständige Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf, Motivationsschreiben, Referenzen und Abschlusszeugnissen einzureichen. Bei Fragen wende dich bitte an Nidhi unter talent@deloitte.ch . * Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden gleichermassen berücksichtigt, unabhängig von Faktoren wie Ethnizität, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Gender-Identität, Nationalität/Herkunft, Alter oder Behinderung, in Übereinstimmung mit den geltenden Gesetzen. Studien zeigen, dass Frauen sich weniger gern bewerben, wenn sie nicht alle Kriterien erfüllen, aber bitte zögere nicht – bewirb dich trotzdem noch heute. Wir akzeptieren für diese Position keine Bewerbungen über Recruiting-Agenturen. © 2026. Für weitere Informationen wenden Sie sich bitte an Deloitte AG. Deloitte AG ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit praktiziert.

titleByLocale.en: Internal Communications Specialist
titleByLocale.it: Internal Communications Specialista
titleByLocale.de: Internal Communications Spezialist
titleByLocale.fr: Internal Communications Spécialiste

jobs.description:
We proudly offer
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location: Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Finding the talent that makes Deloitte unique Are you a skilled, organised and creative communications professional? Are you a strong team player, deliver tangible outcomes and thrive in fast-paced environments? Do you want to advance your career with one of the world’s leading professional services firms? I f this sounds like you, the Deloitte Communications team is looking for you! The Communications & Public Affairs team creates and delivers content that positions Deloitte as thought leaders in a wide range of fields – from business transformation and the future of work to the latest AI developments and other industry-specific topics. We create integrated and innovative communication strategies to engage with our external and internal audiences via the whole span of channels, from websites and blogs to PR and social media to intranet and digital signage. You will work within the Growth division, alongside marketing, eminence, brand, client relations, business development and research teams. Together, we shape strategic go-to-market programs addressing today’s business challenges of Deloitte’s C-suite clients and internal communities. Your work will have immediate, visible impact. How you can make an impact
• Drive internal engagement through strategic campaigns: You will partner with the executive team, business departments, finance, marketing, compliance, and IT to design and launch internal communication campaigns. You will own the campaign pipeline, coordinate across teams and stakeholders, and measure what works using data analytics to shape future strategies.
• Create compelling content across all channels: You will develop and manage content for our internal communications app/platform, intranet, digital signage, and videos, and all in English. Your work is clear, engaging, and designed to reach our people where they are.
• Build a culture where everyone feels heard: Through transparent, inclusive communications, you will amplify Deloitte’s values, diversity, and equity initiatives. You will ensure all voices feel valued and help foster a workplace where people want to stay and grow.
• Innovate and lead beyond your role: You will continuously develop new ideas and tools to communicate more effectively. You will support in wider strategic communications, digital, and brand projects, and play an active role in helping to give Switzerland a voice in the Deloitte EMEA / Global internal communications community and share best practices. Who we are looking for
• You have a Master’s degree in Corporate Communications, Economics, Law, or a related field and bring a minimum of 5 years of professional experience in internal or external communications.
• You have delivered results in internal or external communications. You have a proven track record developing and delivering effective, engaging campaigns, ideally in a large organisation or PR agency. You understand what works, and how to measure it.
• You write with clarity and confidence. You write to a high professional standard in English and can make complex ideas tangible and compelling. Bonus: you speak German or French.
• You are fluent in digital and you think strategically about it. You know your way around communication apps, intranet platforms, videos, blogs and podcasts. More importantly, you choose the right channel for the right message and understand how to drive engagement across them.
• You excel at event production and management. You have hands-on experience planning, producing, and executing corporate town halls or events, and producing post-town hall assets and polls. You manage logistics, coordinate speakers and panellists, oversee technical production (AV and hybrid setups), and ensure flawless execution. You thrive under pressure, anticipate challenges, and adapt quickly when things change.
• You learn fast and inspire people. You quickly grasp how our business works and what our people care about. Then you create content that resonates, content that informs, engages, and inspires action.
• You thrive in complexity. You juggle multiple projects, priorities, and stakeholders without losing sight of the bigger picture. You are a strong team player with a positive, flexible, hands-on approach and you bring an entrepreneurial spirit to problem-solving.
• You champion inclusion and navigate change. You understand and appreciate diverse cultures, and you actively promote an inclusive work environment. You have guided employees through organisational change, communicating transitions clearly and maintaining morale and trust throughout. If this sounds like you, you will find a team that values your expertise, supports your growth, and gives you the platform to shape how Deloitte communicates with their workforce. Your team You will join a diverse, multinational team of communicators who are genuinely invested in your success. We invest in your growth through structured training, mentoring programs, and on-the-job learning, but also by connecting with your colleagues across all business lines. Your teammates are motivated, collaborative, and curious. They challenge ideas respectfully, celebrate wins together, and support each other through difficult projects. Access to global networks, exposure to diverse perspectives, and the chance to work on high-impact campaigns means you will develop skills and confidence quickly. Careers at Deloitte. Choose your impact. At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective help us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.apply.deloitte.ch . How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on “apply now” to submit a complete application, including CV and cover letter. If you have any questions, please contact Stefanie Niklas at talent@deloitte.ch We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law. Research shows that women are less likely to apply for roles unless they match all the criteria; don’t hold yourself back – apply today. We do not accept applications from recruitment agencies for this position. Requisition ID: 23894

A core part of managing risk are internal controls and the appropriate management of third parties. The increasing burden of maintaining adherence to regulatory requirements means that reducing the cost of compliance is currently a key priority on many Board agendas. We strive to help our clients by using different techniques and technology to build up cost-conscious risk frameworks that correspond to their continuously changing business needs. How you can make an impact
• Assisting in developing basic control frameworks under supervision
• Supporting the identification of operational, compliance, and regulatory requirements; helping to spot automation opportunities and assisting in designing simple internal controls to help manage risk
• Gaining hands-on experience with the latest technologies and learning how they impact a company's internal control environment
• Assisting senior consultants in advising organizations on Supply Chain Risk and Resilience Management strategies, and learning about industry best practices and regulations
• Supporting the team in building and maintaining client relationships in the risk and controls area, and contributing to the growth of our practice Who we are looking for
• You are in your last semester of your Master’s or Bachelor’s degree or you just completed your studies (common applications come from economics, politics, business administration and management)
• Eagerness to build knowledge and expertise of the core business processes (e.g. PTP, OTC, RTR, Treasury, Tax, HR, etc.) and respective business risks and process level controls
• Knowledge of Enterprise Resource Planning systems (mainly SAP) and other technologies is an advantage
• Previous internship with Enterprise Resource Planning systems (mainly SAP) and other technologies is an advantage
• You are fluent in English and at least one of German or French

We proudly offer:
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location : Geneva, Zurich Switzerland Work Pattern Percentage : 80-100% Duration : 6 months Help our clients solve the biggest challenges of their IT organisation In our Technology Strategy & Transformation Team, our expertise is rooted in a deep understanding of technology coupled with excellent communications skills and broader business understanding. We work together with some of the largest organisations in Switzerland and the world to introduce the change that really makes an impact for their business. Would you like to be part of a team that helps a world-leading bank on its journey to establish the largest European wealth management entity, standardizing and enhancing the customer experience across all key markets in Europe? Or would you like to develop the commercial strategy for a Swiss chemical company across its global markets, building customer segmentation and a channel operating model to address challenging local market conditions? Then join our Technology Strategy & Transformation Team! How you can make an impact
• As an Intern, you will gain hands-on experience from day one, supporting our client engagements to solve their most pressing challenges and opportunities. In this role, you will be mainly responsible for:
• Work in a client-facing role on projects in key industries
• Be integrated into a project team from the start and work in partnership with the customer and - with support from experienced colleagues - on challenging problems and solutions
• Get involved in projects that span across IT Strategy and Operating Model design, IT Architecture, IT Business Management, IT Agility Advisory, IT Transitions and Transformations, IT M&A Conduct analysis, take part in workshops and status meetings and prepare documents and presentations Who are we looking for?
• You are a recent graduate or a high performing student completing your Master’s degree in the field of Information Systems, Business and/or Engineering with exposure to IT topics
• You have a strong eagerness to learn and foundational exposure to IT topics, previous internships or work experience within IT Consulting or an IT department of a global company is desirable but not essential
• You have a passion for IT innovation and awareness of major technology trends (Agile Methodology, Robotics Process Automation, Cloud, etc.)
• You enjoy working methodically, in a structured way and with great attention to detail
• You are curious and have a thirst for knowledge, bringing a fresh perspective in what you do
• You communicate confidently in English and German or French Your team At Deloitte, our Technology Strategy & Transformation specialists help organizations develop the strategies and implement the systems that build business value and drive performance. We have the in-depth knowledge and experience gained from working on some of the most complex IT challenges around the globe, everything from system replacement to full IT transformation. jobs.description:
We proudly offer
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location : Zurich Work Pattern Percentage : 80-100% Curious about how the financial world really works — and how regulation shapes the future of banks and financial institutions? If you’re eager to learn, excited to explore regulatory topics, and want to gain hands‑on experience in a dynamic consulting environment, then this is the place to kick‑start your journey. Join a team of business, finance and legal experts that helps financial institutions stay ahead in a world shaped by constant change. We work on topics that matter — from solving strategic and legal challenges, implementing new regulations, managing non‑financial and compliance risks in an increasingly complex environment. As an intern, you’ll be part of project teams, gain hands-on experience from experts, and build the skills that set the foundation for your future career.
• Support on strategic, risk, regulatory, compliance and legal projects in the Swiss financial services sector
• Assist in reviewing processes, governance structures, compliance frameworks and support the design of optimized workflows, operating models under the guidance of experienced team members
• Help prepare presentations, reports, and documentation for internal and client-facing use
• Collaborate with team members across disciplines to support daily project work and internal initiatives How you can make an impact
• Work on strategic risk, regulatory and legal topics that shape the future of financial services at top tier financial institutions
• Learn from a highly motivated team with deep expertise in Swiss and European financial market regulation — and grow your skills every day
• Bring your curiosity and analytical mindset to the team by supporting research, analysis, and preparation of client deliverables
• Contribute to internal initiatives such as thought leadership, market insights, or proposal preparation — and discover how consulting firms position themselves in the market Who We Are Looking For
• Bachelor’s or Master’s student or graduate with an excellent academic record in law, business, economics, finance, engineering or a similar field
• Strong interest in financial services, legal, regulatory and compliance topics
• First practical experience through internships or university projects is a plus
• Analytical mindset, strong quantitative and conceptual skills, curiosity and willingness to learn
• You are fluent in English and German Your Team You will join our Zurich-based team of interdisciplinary experts, combining backgrounds in law, economics, finance, and technology. We are a diverse, collaborative, and international group that thrives on tackling complex regulatory and compliance challenges from multiple perspectives. We value knowledge sharing, mutual support, and innovative thinking. Working with us means joining a dynamic environment where you can take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a tangible impact for our clients. Careers at Deloitte. Choose your impact. At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. jobs.description:
We proudly offer
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Help our clients to find vulnerabilities before cyber-criminals do Do you enjoy the thrill of hacking into systems on online training platforms or bug bounty programs? Would you like to turn your passion into a career and help us protecting our clients’ systems? Do you want to kickstart your career at the global leader in cyber security consulting and grow your career as ethical hacker / penetration tester? As an ethical hacker / penetration tester, you will work with clients across various industries to ensure their applications and infrastructure are secure. You will be supported by your team who will help you to leverage your prior experience while growing and building up your penetration testing expertise and staying up to date with the latest tools, techniques, and procedures. How you can make an impact:
• Perform penetration tests for web and mobile applications and other security assessments such as code reviews where technical skills are essential
• Document your findings in a high-quality, easy to read report, present it to the client and explain the steps required for remediation
• Share your expertise as part of wider projects in the area of red teaming, IT risks and regulatory projects
• Participate in team problem solving efforts and offer ideas to solve client issues
• Support business development activities such as proposal and presentation preparation Who we are looking for:
• You have a passion for cyber security and the desire to build your Consulting career as a penetration tester in our application security team
• You participated in CTF events, hacking challenges such as Hack The Box or bug bounty programs
• You have a completed Bachelor or Master’s degree with a strong academic record in computer science or a similar field
• A good understanding of the OWASP Top 10 and penetration testing related certifications such as OSCP or OSWE are a strong advantage
• Software development skills would be a plus
• Experience in vulnerability management would be an added advantage.
• You are completely fluent in English, fluency in German is a strong advantage Your team Become part of an entrepreneurial, innovative and international team of 60 Cyber professionals across Switzerland. We are passionate about bringing best in class cyber solutions to our clients and helping our people grow both personally and professionally through trainings, mentoring programmes and on-the-job learning. jobs.description:
We proudly offer
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Drive Progress in a Dynamic Digital World Do you want to use your cyber expertise, entrepreneurial and innovative mindset to protect companies and society from digital threats, thus making the world a little safer? As the undisputed global leader in cyber security, we work with more than 80% of the Fortune Global 500 companies. Join us as we support the next generation of cyber talent, invest in emerging technologies and drive progress in a dynamic, digital world. How you can make an impact * You will apply your knowledge of the client needs and industries to identify relevant cyber risks and develop a tailored strategy on how to best navigate those. * You will take a leading role in supporting clients' large-scale transformational projects, applying not only your security expertise but also project management experience and social skills. * You will apply innovative thinking to define cost-effective cyber strategies as well implementation recommendations by leveraging your experience, market knowledge and our international network of cybersecurity experts. * You will collaborate with an interdisciplinary and varied set of team members, client stakeholders and service providers from across the globe. * You will actively create and manage lasting relationships with a diverse set of stakeholders, building on trust as the foundation for business success. Who we are looking for * You are a proactive and entrepreneurial professional who takes ownership, thrives on challenges, and stays abreast of cyber security trends and market developments. * You bring 5+ years of experience in professional services advisory, with a strong technical background in cyber strategy and risk management consulting, and a proven ability to deliver large-scale cyber security projects in both subject matter expert and team leadership roles. * You have strong interpersonal and business development skills, with the ability to build trusted client relationships, influence senior stakeholders, and lead teams in an advisory environment. * You are an experienced Manager, ideally with prior consulting experience in a Big Four or equivalent environment, and bring a strong understanding of the Romandie market. * You are based in the Romandie region, speak French and English fluently, and ideally have an established local professional network. * Certifications such as CISSP, GSTRT, or CISM are considered an advantage. Your team Become part of an entrepreneurial, innovative and international team of 60 Cyber professionals across Switzerland. We are passionate about bringing best in class cyber solutions to our clients and helping our people grow both personally and professionally through trainings, mentoring programmes and on-the-job learning. jobs.description:
We proudly offer
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location: Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80% - 100% Join our Crisis & Resilience Experts Major crises demand the very best from our clients. We want them to count on us to help rise to the occasion and respond with resilience and character. That means preparing, predicting, preventing, managing, and recovering – so they emerge stronger. Our approach is designed to stay ahead of growing threats caused by major crises events. It begins by identifying and preparing for disruptions, and spans a broad portfolio of offerings including preparation, simulation, monitoring, response, and recovery. One integrated offering, at the ready for clients in need. Our Crisis & Resilience team sits within Cyber Risk Services, part of Technology and Transformation in Deloitte Switzerland. How you can make an impact:
• As a Crisis & Resilience Manager, you will be part of Deloitte’s subject matter expert group helping clients to prepare for and successfully navigate through disruptions and crises
• You will utilise your expertise in delivering challenging projects to our client base, aiming to improve maturity in the areas of resilience including but not limited to continuity management, crisis management and recovery
• You will partake in business development activities, enhancing our Crisis & Resilience propositions and building new client relationships Who we are looking for
• A strong personal desire to be a vital part in helping clients to prepare for and navigate successfully through crisis situations
• Next to Crisis & Resilience related matters – a strong interest to learn, grow and contribute in wider risk management and cyber related topics
• Existing subject matter expertise in one or multiple resilience areas of continuity management, crisis management and/or recovery
• Existing credentials in the areas of Incident and Crisis Management, Risk Management and Cyber Security are an advantage (e.g. ISO 22301 Lead Implementer, BCI Accreditation, CISSP, CISM, CISA, etc.)
• Fluency in English and German is required Your team Become part of a diverse, multinational and highly motivated team of around 80+ cybersecurity professionals across Switzerland . We will help you grow both personally and professionally: through our trainings, mentoring programmes and on-the-job learning, but also by connecting with your colleagues across all business lines. Drive secure digital transformation for our clients We focus on enabling our clients' end-to-end digital transformation journey with our Security by Design approach. To this end, you will be expected to develop secure architectures that support clients' business and security objectives, as well as develop actionable approaches for adoption. How you can make an impact
• Engage with client to understand client threat landscape and Cyber risks
• Develop a Cloud security, network security vision, strategy, roadmap and design principles
• Lead team to develop high-level design (HLD), low-level design (LLD) and implementation of security solutions defined in the strategy
• Assist clients with the adoption of modern Cloud security capabilities (e.g. Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), Cloud Workload Protection Platform (CWPP), Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB), secure CI/CD pipeline, data security and compliance, or similar), and network infrastructure capabilities (e.g., Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), Software-Defined Wide Area Networks (SD-WAN), Software-Defined Perimeter (SDP), Software-Defined Networks (SDN), or similar) Who we are looking for
• You have minimum 5 years of related experience in technical advisory role, providing professional services or internal consulting in the field of security.
• You possess good observational and problem-solving skills, as well as the ability to articulate complex concepts in a clear and concise manner. You are passionate about the subjects of Cybersecurity, Cloud, network, and Zero Trust, and have experience in several key security domains.
• You have a relevant educational background in Information Technology, Information Systems Security, Cybersecurity, or a related field. You possess a strong foundation across the Cybersecurity technology stack, including secure Cloud infrastructure in AWS, Azure, or GCP, market-leading technology offerings, and experience with enterprise networking, security engineering (on-premises and Cloud), and Identity and Access Management principles. You have experience using security technologies such as Cisco, Palo Alto, CrowdStrike, Zscaler, and Netskope, or similar.
• It would be advantageous to have certifications in Enterprise Security Architecture (e.g SABSA), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) and/or Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP)

• Fluency in English is mandatory, German or/and French would be considered as desired. jobs.description:
Was wir mit Stolz bieten: •Ein sicheres Arbeitsumfeld mit null Toleranz gegenüber Belästigung. •Offene Arbeitswelten, in denen Menschen sich selbst sein können. •Eine inklusive Gemeinschaft, die auf Respekt und Leistung basiert. Location : Zurich, Bern Work Pattern Percentage : 80-100% Mach die Welt ein bisschen sicherer! Starte deine Karriere in der Wirtschaftsprüfung - Begib dich auf eine spannende berufliche Reise und gestalte so die Zukunft der Wirtschaftsprüfung mit. In der Wirtschaftsprüfung befasst du dich mit einer Vielzahl von Themen, die alle wirtschaftlichen und gesellschaftlichen Aspekte berühren: vom Schutz von Vermögenswerten bis hin zur Bewältigung globaler Grossereignisse. Deine Arbeit beeinflusst die Entscheidungen von Kunden, Finanzmärkten und der Gesellschaft, schafft Vertrauen und bringt Transparenz in die globale Finanzwelt. Bei uns geht es um mehr als nur um Zahlen - Bei Deloitte sind wir überzeugt, dass es bei der Prüfung und Beratung nicht nur um Zahlen und Finanzberichte geht. Viel mehr ist es unser Ziel, Vertrauen zu schaffen, Innovationen voranzutreiben und Unternehmen in ihrem Wachstum zu unterstützen. Möchtest du künftig diese Leidenschaft mit uns teilen? Was dich bei uns erwartet und wie du einen "Impact that matters" machen kannst
• Vom ersten Tag an stehst du im direkten Kontakt mit unseren Kunden und leistest so einen relevanten und wichtigen Beitrag. Dabei prüfst du Konzern- und Jahresabschlüsse nach nationalen und/oder internationalen Rechnungslegungsstandards.
• "Fast-Track" – Du gehest einen klaren und langfristigen Karriereweg mit stetiger Weiterbildung in Fach- und Sozialkompetenzen, sowie unserer Beteilung an deiner Qualifizierung zum/zur eidg. dipl. Wirtschaftsprüfer/in.
• Flexibilität ist uns wichtig - Dein künftiges Team arbeitet in einem hybriden Arbeitsmodel, das heisst wir sind sowohl beim Kunden vor Ort, in Deloitte Offices oder aber auch zu Hause.
• Deloitte Way of Working - Ermöglicht dir die Nutzung innovativer Tools und Technologien im Arbeitsalltag, die ständig erweitert und verbessert werden. Dabei sind Datenanalysen und IT-Kenntnisse unumgänglich.
• Kein Tag wie der andere - Die täglichen Herausforderungen ermöglichen dir ein vertieftes Verständnis für Risiken, Prozesse und Strategien zu entwickeln, um Schritt für Schritt zu einem/einer gefragten Experten/in zu werden. Was du mitbringst
• Du bringst einen Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss (Uni oder FH) in Wirtschaftswissenschaften mit (von Vorteil mit einer Spezialisierung in Audit, Accounting, Finance oder Controlling) und erste Praxiserfahrungen.
• Du hast ausgezeichnete analytische Fähigkeiten, eine rasche Auffassungsgabe, und Interesse daran, komplexe Aufgabenstellungen schnell und präzise zu lösen.
• Du kommst mit einer positiven und ergebnisorientieren Einstellung sowie der Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und individuelle Lösungen für unsere Kunden zu finden.
• Ein Match mit unseren Grundwerten: "Be curious and courageous, respectful and integrative.".
• Motivation die Ausbildung als eidg. dipl. Wirtschaftsprüfer/in bei ExpertSuisse zu absolvieren (https://www.expertsuisse.ch/ausbildung).
• Fliessendes Deutsch und Englisch; weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus. Dein Team Werde Teil eines vielfältigen, multinationalen und hochmotivierten Teams an unserem Standort in Zürich. Wir helfen dir, sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich zu wachsen: dies durch unsere internen Schulungen, Mentoring-Programme und das “Learning on the Job”, aber auch durch die Vernetzung mit Kollegen aus allen Geschäftsbereichen. Im Audit & Assurance Team glauben wir an ein gemeinsames Ziel, bei dem wir dazu beitragen, das öffentliche Interesse und das Vertrauen in die Wirtschaft zu schützen, und wir bieten Organisationen unabhängige Sicherheit, damit sie die richtigen Entscheidungen treffen können. Du bringst den Ehrgeiz mit, wir wir bieten dir die Chancen. Wir unterstützen unsere Mitarbeiter dabei, sich selbst zu sein, und wir erkennen die kollektive Stärke unserer unterschiedlichen Hintergründe an. Darüber hinaus unterstützen wir uns gegenseitig und nehmen Veränderungen gemeinsam als Team an und bieten schliesslich eine einzigartige und inspirierende Entwicklungsreise, um Ihre Fähigkeiten und Fertigkeiten zu erweitern, die du jetzt und in Zukunft benötigst. Karrieren bei Deloitte. Wähle deinen Impact. In der Schweiz bieten wir branchenspezifische Dienstleistungen in den Bereichen Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory und Technology & Transformation an. Mit beinahe 3 000 Mitarbeitenden an sechs Standorten betreuen wir Unternehmen und Organisationen jeder Grösse und aller Branchen. Wir bieten dir eine sinnvolle und anspruchsvolle Arbeit, einen Ort, an dem du einfach du selbst sein kannst und immer weiter über dich hinauswachsen kannst. Profitiere von unseren hybriden Arbeitsbedingungen sowie von Wellbeing- und Elternprogrammen. Komm in unser Team und werde Teil eines globalen Netzwerks von Gleichgesinnten, die sich dafür einsetzen, einen echten Unterschied zu machen, ob in Sachen Klimawandel oder indem sie bis 2030 die Zukunftsperspektiven von 100 Millionen Menschen verbessern. Neugierig auf deine Chancen und Möglichkeiten bei Deloitte? Besuche uns auf www.Apply.deloitte.ch . So bewirbst du dich? Wir freuen uns von dir zu hören! Bitte klicke auf "apply now", um eine vollständige Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf, Motivationsschreiben, Zeugnissen und Referenzen einzureichen. Bei Fragen wenden Sie sich bitte an Emilia unter talent@deloitte.ch *Wir berücksichtigen alle qualifizierten Bewerber unabhängig von Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, religiöser Überzeugung, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität, nationaler Herkunft, Alter oder Behinderung in Übereinstimmung mit geltendem Recht. Untersuchungen zeigen, dass Frauen sich seltener auf Stellen bewerben, wenn sie nicht alle Kriterien erfüllen. Halte dich nicht zurück – bewirb dich noch heute. Wir akzeptieren keine Bewerbungen von Personalvermittlungsagenturen für diese Position. Deloitte Consulting AG und Deloitte AG sind Tochtergesellschaften von Deloitte NSE LLP, einem Mitgliedsunternehmen der Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu Limited ("DTTL"), eine "UK private company limited by guarantee" (eine Gesellschaft mit beschränkter Haftung nach britischem Recht) Requisition reference: 19783

jobs.description:
We proudly offer:
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location: Zürich Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Help our clients successfully manage global challenges Launch your career as a Consultant in our Tax & Legal team you will advise demanding clients on complex taxation issues. Our Tax team offers a wide range of integrated tax services that help our clients to successfully manage local and global challenges. In this role, you will also advise national and international clients on leading strategies to simplify tax management and achieve global visibility for making informed strategic decisions. Be part of a team in which not only numbers are processed, but success is celebrated. How you can make an impact
• Get the opportunity to be involved in activities with client contact and be responsible for cross-divisional projects in various industries from the first day.
• Together with your team, advise our clients on complex tax issues, for example in the tax planning of a multinational company or in an M&A transaction.
• Develop a clear, long-term career path with internal and external professional training offers as well as the time and financial assistance necessary for the training to become a dipl. Tax expert or study the MAS FH in Swiss and International Taxation / LL.M. Swiss and International Taxation.
• Be part of an international and interdisciplinary team with plenty of learning on the job opportunities Who We Are Looking For
• You are curious and bold, respectful and integrative. You bring a positive and result-oriented attitude as well as the willingness to take over responsibility and find solutions for various clients.
• You have a flair for numbers and business connections as well as thirst for knowledge that enrich our projects with new perspectives.
• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s from a university or university of applied sciences degree in law, business administration or a similar field, ideally with tax knowledge.
• Experience in the tax field in as advantage
• You communicate confidently in German and English. Any further languages would be an advantage. Your Team Become part of a fun, highly motivated team of 30+ at our Zurich office. We don’t only like crunching numbers, but also enjoy spending time together as a team doing social events etc. We value teamwork and interdisciplinary work across all business lines. We will help you grow both personally and professionally: through our trainings, mentoring programmes and on-the-job learning. Careers at Deloitte. Choose your impact. At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. We proudly offer:
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location : Geneva, Zurich Switzerland Work Pattern Percentage : 80-100% Advise international clients on cutting edge business areas At Deloitte, our Technology Strategy & Transformation specialists help organizations develop the strategies and implement the systems that build business value and drive performance. We have the in-depth knowledge and experience gained from working on some of the most complex IT challenges around the globe, everything from system replacement to full IT transformation. By enriching us, you will gain valuable insights into IT Strategy and Operating Model design, IT Architecture, IT Business Management, IT Agility Advisory, and IT M&A - great to have you with us! How you can make an impact
• Work in a client-facing role on projects in key industries, like consulting a world-leading bank on its journey to establish the largest European wealth management, or developing the commercial strategy for a Swiss chemical company across its global markets
• Collaborate with the customer and – with support from your experienced colleagues – on challenging problems and solutions
• Conduct analysis, take part in workshops and status meetings, and prepare documents and presentations
• Support Chief Information Officers and their teams in designing and implementing projects to solve the biggest challenges of their IT organisation Who are we looking for?
• • Besides being a reliable character, you enjoy working methodically, have a great attention to detail and a thirst for knowledge, bring in fresh perspectives to a fast-paced environment, and excel at following through and getting things done
• You have relevant internships or work experience within IT Consulting or an IT department of a global company, demonstrating practical knowledge and readiness for the role
• You have graduated with your Master’s degree in Information Systems, Business, and/or Engineering, with strong exposure to IT topics
• A passion for IT innovation and awareness of major technology trends (Agile Methodology, Robotics, Cloud, etc.) distinguishes you
• You like to travel regularly and communicate fluently in English and German/French, proficiency in additional languages is a plus Your team By joining our team in Geneva or Zurich in this entry-level position, you will be integrated into a diverse bunch of congenial colleagues right from the start. We take your further development seriously and offer you a comprehensive internal and external training programme (e.g. several certifications like ITIL, SAFe, PRINCE2). You will also benefit from our expertise in a deep understanding of technology, coupled with excellent communications skills and broader business understanding. jobs.description:
We proudly offer:
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location: Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Help our clients to align strategic business goals with AI innovation to unlock transformative value Deloitte AI & Data empowers clients to harness AI and data not only as technological assets but as strategic enablers that drive business growth and competitive advantage. We bridge the gap between overarching business objectives and complex technical capabilities, ensuring AI initiatives deliver measurable impact aligned with corporate strategy. This role is ideal for professionals who combine strong business acumen with a solid understanding of AI technologies, capable of supporting the development of AI strategies and translating business goals into actionable AI operating models and use case enablement roadmaps. How you can make an impact:
• Collaborate with clients to define AI strategies that align with their business vision, market positioning, and operational priorities.
• Translate strategic business goals into clear AI use cases, requirements, and implementation roadmaps.
• Contribute to thought leadership on AI adoption, governance, ethical considerations, and risk management in line with organisational objectives.
• Support cross-functional collaboration between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure alignment and successful delivery.
• Assist in business development by identifying strategic AI opportunities and supporting the development of compelling proposals.
• Build client relationships through quality project delivery, advisory and delivery excellence. Who we are looking for Drive and Motivation:
• Passionate about the intersection of AI, business strategy, and innovation.
• Eager to build expertise in AI strategy consulting and influence business transformation.
• Self-motivated and able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment with guidance from senior colleagues. Consulting and Communication Skills:
