jobs.description:
Location: Zurich Switzerland Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Help transform our clients’ organisations to support their business strategy What do we do? Our Human Capital team helps organizations manage and sustain their performance through their most important asset: their people. Leveraging research, analytics, and industry insights, we support clients to design and execute critical programs from business driven HR to innovative talent, leadership, organizational and change programs in business and technology transformations. We are the largest Human Capital practice in the Swiss market and are widely recognized by our clients for our ability to walk in their shoes as a true partner, bring leading insight, expertise and consistently deliver high quality work. The nature of our work varies greatly, but chances are your engagement will involve all of the following over time: Recruitment, Compensation, Analytics, Performance Management, Talent & Succession Planning Management, Pensions, Organisation Design, HR strategy, HR Transformation, HR Technology & Adoption, Change Management, Strategic Communications and Culture Transformations, all aiming to maximise shareholder and customer value. How you can make an impact We are looking for a person who enjoys addressing business human capital questions in an analytical manner, who has the patience to structure decision making, and who strives to develop pragmatic recommendations, tempered by experience. Our aspiration is to help clients to gain or maintain competitive advantage against an ever-changing market context. Our clients value us for our ability to see the vision through to reality, producing a plan and approach to successfully bring our client's human capital strategy to life. Your job responsibilities and how you can make an impact that matters. You will:
• Work directly with Swiss and international clients throughout all phases of the organizational change management lifecycle, from initial assessment and planning of the organizational change management strategy to execution, hypercare and adoption review with the right metrics.
• Introduce and embed best practice change management frameworks, governance, processes, and tools to support successful organizational transitions and stakeholder engagement at all stages.
• Act as a key team member liaising with client leaders and internal stakeholders to align change initiatives with business objectives and ensure effective communication and collaboration.
• Contribute to Deloitte’s business development efforts and proposal creation by partnering with Human Capital, other Deloitte service offerings, and account teams to design compelling change management solutions.
• Support the growth and enhancement of Deloitte’s change management capabilities and service offerings within the Human Capital practice. Who are we looking for:
• Strong academic background, ideally a Master’s degree or MBA from a reputable institution, or equivalent professional experience.
• With a bachelors degree, minimum 2-4 years and with a masters degree/MBA minimum1 year of relevant experience in Consulting or a similar role within the Human Capital domain, preferably with exposure to international projects.
• Solid experience in people strategy and change management, particularly in contexts such as large technology implementation programs and/or organizational business transformations.
• Experience contributing to client projects related to Learning & Development, Training & Re-skilling, with familiarity in ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft) and other system implementations (e.g., Salesforce, Workday, SuccessFactors).
• Strong affinity with technology and a deep understanding of its impact on the workforce, including how digital transformation shapes employee experience, skills requirements, and organizational change.
• Willingness and ability to support business development and offering enhancement initiatives.
• Demonstrated capability in managing stakeholder relationships strategically.
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with clients and internal teams.
• Positive, proactive attitude with a focus on delivering high-quality client service and contributing to team success.
• Fluency in written and spoken English and German is essential; proficiency in additional languages such as French is an advantage.
• Knowledge or experience in Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications in Human Capital or Change Management is a plus, including how AI can enhance employee engagement, learning, communication, and decision-making processes (is an advantage)
• Experience in Project Management and proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders or coordinating cross-functional teams in complex environments is a strong plus.
• Willingness to travel within Switzerland and internationally as required. Your Team Become part of a diverse, multinational and highly motivated team. We will help you grow both personally and professionally: through our trainings, mentoring programmes and on-the-job learning, but also by connecting with your colleagues across all business lines. Life at Deloitte At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. We proudly offer:
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location: Zurich/Basel Work Pattern Percentage: 80% - 100% Join Our Innovative IT Team as an Azure Cloud Engineer! Are you passionate about cloud technology and eager to make a real impact? We’re seeking a dynamic and proactive Azure Cloud Engineer with expertise in Infrastructure as Code and a structured problem-solving mindset. In this role, you’ll quickly master and manage our unique dual-cloud environment, including the exclusive "Sovereign Cloud Switzerland" platform—operated entirely within Switzerland—and Deloitte’s regional cloud workloads. You will play a key role throughout the entire lifecycle of our cloud platforms, driving continuous improvement with a strong focus on automation and operational excellence, l everaging emerging AI technologies where appropriate. Collaborate closely with our business teams to seamlessly integrate new applications, enhancing efficiency and productivity. Plus, you’ll have the advantage of tapping into the extensive knowledge and resources of a leading g lobal organisation. If you’re ready to innovate, automate, and elevate cloud operations in a supportive and forward-thinking environment, we want to hear from you! How you can make an impact
• Develop and manage the technical capabilities of our cloud operations team in Switzerland.
• Build and maintain the cloud platform while also supporting multiple Azure solutions to meet business needs.
• Collect and exchange best-practice knowledge among our international cloud teams.
• Develop and maintain automation solutions to deploy platform and application workloads.
• Monitor and manage technical escalations for cloud operations and identify new tools and practices to improve upon our cloud platform. Who we are looking for
• You consistently demonstrate excellent communication skills. You proactively reach out when needed and step in with your expertise to add significant value, ensuring that projects run smoothly and efficiently.
• Not only are you curious and comfortable to adapt to new technologies, but you’re also a great learner with the ability to share your knowledge with your team members.
• You are a certificated Azure Admin Associate (AZ-104) and Azure DevOps Expert.
• (AZ-400), any additional certifications (cloud architecture, system administration, or development) are a great asset.
• Over the course of your career, you have gained experience of automation and provisioning approaches, using tools such as Ansible, Terraform, Bicep, Bash, PowerShell, Python, and C#.
• In-depth knowledge of configuring and managing Windows and Linux environments, experience with infrastructure (databases, Active Directory, DNS, firewalls, networking) in Azure and on-premises data centres would be an advantage.
• Knowledge of agile software development tools and methodologies. Your Team You will be joining an already established and growing DevOps team which has made great strides in bridging the gap between the business and IT. jobs.description:
We proudly offer:
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location: Zurich, Geneva Work Pattern Percentage: 80% - 100% Finding the talent that makes Deloitte unique The vision of our Assurance practice is to be the strategic partner to Finance leaders by leveraging our deep expertise in accounting and controls to build confidence in the value, accuracy, timeliness and reliability of the Controllership function. With Controls Assurance, we deliver services that provide confidence in an organisation's internal control and ensure a framework that meets financial, operational, and legal requirements. Your day-to-day tasks may include leading projects and teams in financial internal controls work and advising clients on issue solving and improvement in the different business areas. How you can make an impact
• As a controls Assistant / Senior focusing on Controls, you will interact with clients directly and you will also collaborate with a diverse group of talented professionals across the firm. You will use our cutting-edge tools and technologies. Responsibilities will include:
• Advise on Internal Controls: Support teams and clients in identifying risks, designing controls, optimizing internal control frameworks, operate mitigation efforts and controls effectively.
• Client & Auditor Collaboration: Interface with external auditors to facilitate compliance assessments and support process and controls owners in addressing control deficiencies.
• Building Relationships: Develop strong, trust-based relationships with clients and team members to drive value and impact.
• Go-to-Market & Innovation: Contribute to Controls Assurance market initiatives, collaborating across teams to enhance service offerings and drive innovation. Who we are looking for
• Proactive and adaptable, with strong interpersonal skills to build relationships with clients and team members.
• Background in finance or accounting, holding a bachelor’s degree or a partial/full accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CPA, etc.).
• Experienced in Big 4 PCAOB audits, with 2 to 3 years of expertise in controls / SOX 404 or equivalent.
• Knowledgeable in core business processes, ICOFR controls, risk management concepts, and relevant IT tools. Skilled in risk assessment and controls, including scoping, reviewing, testing, deficiency evaluation, optimization, design, implementation, and remediation.
• Strong analytical skills, accuracy and problem-solving abilities.
• Excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills in French and English (German is a plus). Your team Become part of a diverse, multinational and highly motivated team based in our Zurich and Geneva office. We will help you grow both personally and professionally: through our trainings, mentoring programmes and on-the-job learning, but also by connecting with your colleagues across all business lines. jobs.description:
Was wir mit Stolz bieten: •Ein sicheres Arbeitsumfeld mit null Toleranz gegenüber Belästigung. •Offene Arbeitswelten, in denen Menschen sich selbst sein können. •Eine inklusive Gemeinschaft, die auf Respekt und Leistung basiert. Ort: Zürich Pensum: 80-100% Zeit für Veränderung und in einem neuen beruflichen Umfeld für Mehrwert zu sorgen?! Für das Deloitte MWST-Team, Hauptarbeitsort Zürich, suchen wir nach Verstärkung auf Senior Manager Stufe. Unser Team von motivierten und vielfältigen Mehrwertsteuerprofis freut sich über eine motivierte Führungskraft, die gleichermassen Freude an nationalen und internationalen Projekten hat. Was dich bei uns erwartet:
• Wir bieten einen abwechslungsreichen Arbeitsalltag, in dem sich alle MWST-Aspekte und Problemstellungen zeigen. Projekte im Bereich Umstrukturierung & Rulinganfragen, Due Diligence, MWST-Compliance aber auch internationale Projekte mit Kunden aus verschiedenen Branchen und MWST-Jurisdiktionen werden zu deinem Portfolio gehören
• Darüber hinaus bieten wir eine enge fachgebietsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit auf Projekten mit Kollegen und Kolleginnen aus dem Management Consulting, Audit und Assurance sowie mit Tax Technology und weiteren Steuerteams bspw. Direkte Steuern, Transfer Pricing, usw.
• Agiere in einer Vorbildfunktion für jüngere Mitarbeitende und unterstütze sie mit deiner Leidenschaft und deinen Fähigkeiten in ihrer beruflichen Entwicklung
• Wir unterstützen dich aktiv bei deiner beruflichen Weiterentwicklung in der Deloitte mit fachlichen wie auch anderen Weiterbildungen Was du mitbringst:
• Die ideale Basis für deine Rolle stellt dein Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Accounting, Finance, Jura oder einem verwandten Fach bzw. eine vergleichbare Ausbildung
• Mehrjährige (ca. 6+) Erfahrung in der Mehrwertsteuerberatung für nationale und internationale Kunden oder vergleichbare Erfahrung im Industrieumfeld, Financial Service Industry Erfahrung ist von Vorteil
• Du hast Interesse an effizienter und lösungsorientierter Arbeit im Team, die auch mal den Status quo in Frage stellt
• Du kannst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und Englisch kommunizieren ‒ Kenntnisse in weiteren Sprachen sind nat ü rlich ein grosses Plus Dein Team Als Teil unseres dynamischen, internationalen und wachsenden Steuerteams in Zürich mit über 320 Kolleginnen und Kollegen findest du ab Tag 1 Menschen, die deine Leidenschaft für Steuern teilen. Zusammen beschäftigt ihr euch nicht nur mit Projekten in der Schweiz, sondern auch an spannenden internationalen Projekten, aus denen sich (inter-)nationale Karrieremöglichkeiten ergeben. Selbstverständlich unterstützen wir dich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich: durch Trainings, Mentoring-Programme und On-the-Job-Learning, aber auch durch den Austausch mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus sämtlichen Geschäftsbereichen. Unser Arbeitsumfeld bietet Chancen für alle, die sich, ihr Team und die Beziehungen zu unseren Kunden weiterentwickeln möchten. So bewirbst du dich Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören! Bitte klicke auf „Jetzt bewerben“, um eine vollständige Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf, Motivationsschreiben, Referenzen und Abschlusszeugnissen einzureichen. Bei Fragen wende dich bitte an Lena unter talent@deloitte.ch Leben bei Deloitte Karrieren bei Deloitte. Wähle deinen Impact. Bei Deloitte haben deine Ideen Wirkung und stossen bedeutsame Veränderungen für unsere Kunden, Menschen und die Gesellschaft an. Deine einzigartige Expertise, Perspektive und dein individueller Hintergrund helfen uns, neue Wege für die komplexesten Herausforderungen zu finden, um so die Zukunft all jener zu verbessern, die von den Auswirkungen unserer Arbeit berührt werden. Bei Deloitte kannst du dir eine Karriere aufbauen, die dich inspiriert und anregt. Bei Deloitte kannst du wirklich etwas bewirken – wie, entscheidest du. In der Schweiz bieten wir branchenspezifische Dienstleistungen in den Bereichen Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory sowie Technology & Transformation an. Mit fast 3'000 Mitarbeitenden an sechs Standorten betreuen wir Unternehmen und Organisationen jeder Grösse und in allen Branchen. Wir bieten dir eine sinn- und anspruchsvolle Arbeit, einen Ort, an dem du einfach du selbst sein kannst und immer weiter über dich hinauswachsen wirst. Profitiere von unseren hybriden Arbeitsbedingungen sowie von Wohlfühl- und Elternprogrammen. Komm in unser Team und werde Teil eines globalen Netzwerks von Gleichgesinnten, die sich dafür einsetzen, einen echten Unterschied zu machen, ob in Sachen Klimawandel oder indem sie bis 2030 die Zukunftsperspektiven von 100 Millionen Menschen verbessern. Neugierig auf deine Chancen und Möglichkeiten bei Deloitte? Besuche uns auf www.deloitte.com/ch/careers . Disclaimer Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden gleichermassen berücksichtigt, unabhängig von Faktoren wie Ethnizität, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Gender-Identität, Nationalität/Herkunft, Alter oder Behinderung, in Übereinstimmung mit den geltenden Gesetzen. Studien zeigen, dass Frauen sich weniger gern bewerben, wenn sie nicht alle Kriterien erfüllen, aber bitte zögere nicht – bewirb dich trotzdem noch heute. Wir akzeptieren für diese Position keine Bewerbungen über Recruiting-Agenturen. Deloitte AG und Deloitte Consulting AG sind Schweizer Zweigniederlassungen von Deloitte LLP, dem DTTL-Mitgliedsunternehmen im Vereinigten Königreich. Requisition number: 19508

titleByLocale.en: (Senior) Manager - SAP Consulting
titleByLocale.it: Responsabile (Senior) - SAP Consulting
titleByLocale.de: (Senior) Manager - SAP Consulting
titleByLocale.fr: (Senior) Manager - SAP Consulting

jobs.description:
We proudly offer:
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location: Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Help our clients realise their full potential Our experts develop strategies and solutions that help our customers manage even the most complex of problems. Is business consultancy your kind of work? Then we're the right company for you. How you can make an impact Our Deloitte SAP consultants evaluate, develop and implement SAP systems for business clients. They determine clients' business needs, create customized SAP solutions, and smoothly integrate SAP applications with existing IT infrastructure Our SAP team delivers business focussed transformation programmes supported by process design, people solutions and technology. We focus on realizing operational improvements and efficiencies across business operations. We partner with the most renowned technology providers globally and combine their tools with our proven expertise to offer the best solutions to our clients. Who we are looking for
• You have extensive experience with SAP driven business transformations
• You are able to manage end-to-end sales processes / “RFP” related dynamics for medium/high complexity clients
• You are able to efficiently interact with CxO-1 counterparts
• You have a proven track-record in SAP configurations for a specific SAP Module, and recent experience in S/4HANA
• You communicate confidently in English and German
• Delivery & Integration Management experience and experience in a leading Consulting firm will be considered a plus Your team Our Deloitte SAP team can help transform your organization and take it to new levels of performance with a suite of solutions centred on the leading-edge SAP S/4 HANA platform. We work with you to plan and implement a full suite of solutions in areas such as enterprise transformation, finance, and supply chain, incorporating advanced technology applications such as artificial intelligence, blockchain, and IoT. Careers at Deloitte. Choose your impact. At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, a place where you can be you and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from hybrid working conditions as well as wellbeing and parental programmes. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.deloitte.com/ch/careers. How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on “apply now” to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates. If you have any questions, please contact Sophia at talent@deloitte.ch *We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law. Research shows that women are less likely to apply for roles unless they match all the criteria; don’t hold yourself back – apply today. Deloitte AG and Deloitte Consulting AG are Swiss subsidiaries of Deloitte LLP, the DTTL member firm in the United Kingdom.

jobs.description:
We proudly offer:
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location: Zurich Work Pattern Percentage : 80% - 100% Help our clients successfully manage global challenges Our Tax Team offers integrated tax services that help our clients to successfully manage local and global challenges as well as advise on guiding strategies to simplify tax management and achieve global visibility for making informed strategic decisions. As part of the team you will support our clients from the financial industry in answering complex tax law questions and will assist mainly institutions in the banking, insurance and fund industry with strategic and operational tax challenges. How you can make an impact
• Advise domestic and foreign financial institutions on international restructurings, the tax treatment of financial products and answer questions regarding their tax reporting obligations
• Deal with operational tax issues such as withholding tax, stamp duties as well as domestic and foreign withholding taxes
• Conduct tax compliance mandates for banks, insurance companies and fund management companies as well as s upport in audit projects by checking tax aspects in the annual financial statements of banks, insurance companies and fund management companies
• Work on international projects where you have client responsibility, offering the opportunity to work creatively and motivated
• Take responsibility for your own career and explore our exciting career opportunities as well as a broad internal and external training programme as well as train our younger employees and contribute to their development Who We Are Looking For
• You hold a degree as a certified tax expert or a specialised Swiss Master's degree (e.g. LL.M. Swiss and International Taxation)
• You have an academic qualification in administration, economics or law and 6 years of experience in the financial services industry and/or tax/legal consulting with a focus on financial services
• A positive and hands-on attitude as well as the willingness to take over responsibility
• You are curious and like to use your technical and investigative skills
• You communicate fluently in German and English. Any additional languages would be an advantage. Your team Become part of a diverse, multinational and highly motivated team. jobs.description:
We proudly offer:
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location: Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Advise international clients on cutting-edge technology for their business As (Senior) Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be the newest member among our Technology Strategy & Transformation specialists and help organizations to develop strategies and implement systems that build business value and drive performance. We combine in-depth knowledge and experience gained from working on some of the most complex IT projects around the globe, from system replacement to full IT transformation. By enriching us, you will gain valuable insights into IT strategy and operating model design, IT architecture, IT business management, IT agility advisory, and IT M&A – we’re looking forward to having you with us! How you can make an impact:

jobs.description:
We proudly offer:
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location: Basel, Zurich, Geneva Work Pattern Percentage: 80% - 100% Help our clients successfully manage global challenges As a (Assistant) Manager in the Global Employer Services (GES) team, you will provide multi-national companies with targeted advice and strategies for running Global Mobility programs in an efficient manner. Our team supports clients with the end-to-end management of global compensation for internationally mobile employees and optimization of Tax compliance and positions. As part of the US Tax team, you will advise on US tax returns and compliance topics and do the final signoff of US tax returns before delivery. How you can make an impact
• Coordinate our global tax compliance services including liaising directly with clients and Deloitte offices worldwide.
• Review and sign US individual income tax returns for US resident and nonresident taxpayers, including Forms 1040, 114, 8938, 1116, 2555, 8858, and other forms specific to US residents with activities outside the United States.
• Review and sign tax reconciliations and tax equalization calculations and lead various other tasks related to the successful delivery of Global Mobility programs for our clients.
• Oversee the completion of tasks and quality of the work done by junior members of the team.
• Interpret and implement International Assignment Policies and ensure consistent global tax treatment of various assignment compensation items and allowances.
• Advise our clients on the tax and social security implications related to various global employment issues including tax residency, avoidance of double taxation and the taxation of complex compensation such as severance payments, long term and short-term incentive income. Who We Are Looking For
• You have successfully completed your Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Economics, Accountancy, or Law.
• You have 5 years+ US tax experience/knowledge and hold relevant qualification (e.g. EA, CPA, etc).
• Experience in global mobility or a “Big-4” firm is a plus.
• You are curious to find answers, take the initiative and are happy taking on responsibility and like to work in project teams with a systematic approach.
• You communicate fluently in English. Any further languages would be an advantage. Your Team Become part of a diverse, multinational and highly motivated team of 8 across our Geneva and Zurich offices.
